The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, excellent communication skills, and a passion for delivering top-notch customer service.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Troubleshoot, investigate, and resolve issues, and engage with product and development teams to solve more complex issues

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the Telzio platform and help customers navigate and utilize all the various features

  • Basic understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, RTC

  • Understanding of networking industry best practices

  • Ability to create accurate documentation for internal and external company use

  • Ability to work 5AM to 2PM PST

  • Can demonstrate technical knowledge or equivalent experience in CompTIA Network +

Bonus (but not required):

  • CompTIA Network+ or similar certification

  • 10 DLC SMS regulation experience

Nift is disrupting performance marketing — we deliver millions of net-new customers to DTC and e-commerce brands every month. We're growing our Mid-Market team, and we're looking for a full-cycle seller to help build it.

This is a true hunter's seat. You'll personally research, prospect, and close net-new Mid-Market DTC & e-commerce advertisers — then own those accounts as they scale. There's no SDR handing you leads and no CS team taking the account off your plate: you open the door, win the business, get the first campaign live, and grow it. Land and expand.

If you've sold a performance-marketing product to growth and marketing leaders and you like the idea of an open field with room to build, keep reading.

Why this role is different

  • Ground-floor seat: Mid-Market is still being built here. You'll help write the playbook, not inherit one.
  • Open remit, real ownership: No rigid territories, no lead handoffs. You self-source, you close, and you keep what you land as it grows.
  • A product that actually converts: Nift introduces brands to new customers through thoughtful "thank-you" gifts — a genuinely differentiated, performance-based acquisition channel, not another ad placement.
  • Comp with upside: Competitive base, balanced 50/50 OTE, uncapped commission, plus equity potential.
  • Learn from the best: You'll work closely with our CRO, Saket Mehta — named to the 2026 Adweek 50

What you'll do

  • Self-source and prospect net-new Mid-Market DTC/e-commerce brands, and quickly qualify inbound leads
  • Run discovery to understand each brand's acquisition goals, CPA/ROAS targets, and conversion paths
  • Show growth and marketing leaders how Nift drives net-new customers, and lead pricing and contract negotiations
  • Own the account after close — get the first campaign live, monitor performance, and scale spend
  • Build and forecast a healthy pipeline, and become Nift's category expert as the market evolves

What you bring

  • 5+ years of sales experience, ideally selling a performance-marketing or customer-acquisition product to marketing / growth / performance teams — with a track record of self-sourcing, closing, and beating quota
  • Full-cycle instincts: you're comfortable owning everything from cold outreach to close to account growth
  • Consultative, data-driven selling: you translate campaign data into a clear, compelling case and connect client goals to platform performance
  • Excellent communication with founders and senior leaders at small-to-mid-size brands
  • Organized and self-driven — you thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured, results-oriented environment, and you're fluent in CRM and modern sales tools

About Nift

Nift is reshaping how people discover and try new brands — helping businesses acquire customers efficiently while making those customers feel valued. We're a data-driven, cash-flow-positive company that's grown 731% over the last three years, scaling toward becoming one of the largest sources of new customer acquisition worldwide. We're backed by Spark Capital & Foundry (early investors in Slack, Snap, Warby Parker, Wayfair, and Twitter).

What you get

  • Competitive comp + comprehensive benefits (401(k) with match, Medical / Dental / Vision)
  • Equity potential for full-time employees
  • Flexible remote work + Unlimited Responsible PTO
  • A direct, visible impact on Nift's revenue, growth, and future

raw.description:
About us

At Avantpage, we open doors through language access to create a brighter future, so every person is heard and can participate with dignity. We help healthcare organizations, government agencies, and other regulated industries deliver critical communications accurately, accessibly, and at scale. Headquartered in Davis, California, we are a global company with team members working remotely around the world to support a follow-the-sun operating model. We are looking for talented professionals ready to live our values of empathy, rigor, and innovation.

Job Overview

The Alternative Formats Quality Coordinator develops, implements, and manages quality assurance processes for accessible communications and alternative-format deliverables.

The role ensures that materials produced by external vendors meet client requirements, applicable accessibility standards, and Avantpage quality expectations.

Working closely with Project Managers, clients, vendors, and internal quality teams, this role reviews and improves the quality of accessible PDFs and electronic text, large print in 18-point Arial, Grade 2 Braille, and audio in CD/MP3 or equivalent formats.

The position serves as Avantpage's subject-matter expert on document accessibility and alternative-format quality, supporting consistent, compliant, and scalable delivery.

The position focuses on quality oversight and vendor management rather than production or remediation.

Reviews are primarily digital. It performs direct QA when an output can be meaningfully evaluated with the available expertise and tools. For specialized, tactile, audio, or language-dependent deliverables that cannot be independently reviewed in full, the coordinator validates the vendor's QA process, evidence, qualifications, and sign-off before acceptance. External vendors remain responsible for production and any required hard-copy proofs or physical delivery.

This role may also participate in client meetings to clarify quality requirements, explain review approaches and findings, and support the resolution of accessibility-related concerns.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Establish, document, and maintain quality assurance standards, procedures, checklists, evaluation criteria, and acceptance requirements for accessible communications and alternative-format projects.
  • Conduct direct QA reviews of accessible PDFs, electronic text or data-CD content, large print in 18-point Arial, and other deliverables that can be evaluated using approved standards, tools, and testing methods.
  • For Braille, audio, tactile, language-dependent, or other specialized outputs that cannot be fully reviewed in-house, evaluate and document the vendor's QA methodology, reviewer qualifications, test results, sampling evidence, and formal sign-off.
  • Review vendor deliverables and supporting quality documentation to determine whether client, contractual, regulatory, and Avantpage requirements have been met before acceptance.
  • Conduct accessibility and usability testing using industry-standard validation tools, screen readers, and assistive technologies; document defects clearly and consistently.
  • Participate in client meetings when needed to clarify requirements, explain QA processes or findings, and support accessibility-related reviews and escalations.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, clients, vendors, and internal subject-matter experts to resolve quality issues, complaints, and accessibility-related risks.
  • Monitor quality metrics and vendor performance; provide clear feedback, corrective-action requests, root-cause guidance, and improvement recommendations.
  • Create and deliver internal training and practical guidance on document accessibility standards, alternative-format QA, and quality expectations.
  • Support audits, client reviews, vendor evaluations, and continuous-improvement initiatives related to accessibility and alternative-format services.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving accessibility regulations, standards, testing methodologies, assistive technologies, and industry best practices.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accessibility, Digital Publishing, Communications, Linguistics, Quality Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in accessibility quality assurance, document accessibility, digital publishing, accessible content, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of WCAG, PDF/UA, document accessibility principles, and manual and automated accessibility-testing methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience reviewing accessible documents, applying structured QA checklists, documenting defects, and validating corrections or acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to determine when direct review is possible and when quality must be validated through a specialized vendor's documented process, credentials, evidence, and sign-off.
  • Familiarity with screen readers and assistive technologies, particularly JAWS and NVDA.
  • Experience using Adobe Acrobat Pro and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and PowerPoint.
  • Strong professional English and the ability to communicate findings clearly in documentation, vendor discussions, and client-facing meetings.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills, with careful attention to quality, traceability, and compliance.

What we offer

  • Joining a vibrant multicultural team spread across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe
  • Professional development and growth opportunities in the localization industry
  • Training in new tools, technologies, and processes
  • Energetic, multicultural, and empathetic working environment

About the Job

Do you remember the teacher who went above and beyond to help you realize your potential? At Vanguard College Prep, we are looking for educators ready to pay that forward. Where other test prep companies hire part-time gig workers to teach 'hacks,' we hire full-time professionals to build lasting core skills. We don't run an assembly line; we treat every student as an individual, preparing them for top-tier colleges and beyond.

  • Base Pay: $20.00 – $24.00 / hour (40 hours/week)

What You Will do:

  • Teach and Inspire: Instruct small groups of students in their English core skills to promote long-term understanding of topics and top scores in their college readiness exams (ACT & SAT).

raw.description:
At Petfolk, we’re reshaping veterinary care by blending high-quality medicine with a welcoming, connected experience for pets, their families, and the professionals who care for them.

Our people are central to that mission. As Petfolk continues to grow, we are building a thoughtful, relationship-driven recruiting team that can connect exceptional veterinary professionals with meaningful career opportunities across our markets.

The Role

The Talent Operations Coordinator is a critical operational partner to the Recruiting team, helping ensure the day-to-day recruiting process runs smoothly, efficiently, and consistently across Petfolk. This role manages recruiting operations, candidate and interview coordination, externship support, recruiting systems, and administrative processes that create a high-quality experience for candidates, recruiters, and hiring teams.

You will serve as a central point of coordination across Talent Acquisition, Talent Operations and other business partners. From opening and maintaining requisitions to coordinating interviews, tracking feedback, managing externship requests, and keeping recruiting systems accurate, you will make sure the details are handled and nothing falls through the cracks.

While this role is highly execution-focused, it also requires someone who looks for ways to make the recruiting function better. The successful candidate will be proactive, highly organized, comfortable managing competing priorities, and motivated by creating structure and consistency in a fast-growing organization.

What You'll Do

  • Intake and manage new requisition requests across Petfolk, ensuring required approvals and documentation are complete.
  • Create, post, edit, maintain, and close requisitions across recruiting platforms.
  • Audit requisitions and job postings for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with recruiting standards.
  • Manage internal and external job board postings and ensure job opportunities remain accurate and up to date.
  • Maintain accurate candidate and requisition information within Petfolk's ATS and recruiting systems.
  • Conduct routine ATS audits and data cleanup to maintain system integrity and data accuracy.
  • Coordinate and schedule candidate interviews across multiple calendars, with a focus on veterinarian recruiting.
  • Send interview confirmations, reminders, scheduling updates, and other timely communications to candidates and interviewers.
  • Manage interview changes, cancellations, and rescheduling while ensuring a seamless candidate experience.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates regarding interview scheduling and logistics.
  • Coordinate on-site interview experiences, including itineraries, candidate packets, interview guides, and travel arrangements when applicable.
  • Follow up on outstanding interview feedback and ensure interviewers complete feedback within established timelines.
  • Escalate overdue feedback and other outstanding recruiting tasks when necessary.
  • Coordinate and complete candidate reference checks.
  • Serve as a resource to recruiters and hiring teams for questions related to candidate coordination and interview logistics.
  • Monitor incoming externship and shadowing requests and provide timely responses to applicants.
  • Determine whether externship applicants meet basic eligibility requirements and coordinate placements with Pet Care Center partners.
  • Maintain accurate externship pipelines, calendars, and records of completed externships.
  • Proactively follow up with candidates and Pet Care Center partners when responses or scheduling confirmations are outstanding.
  • Monitor adherence to recruiting processes and service-level expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows, systems, and operational efficiency.
  • Assist with testing and implementation of new recruiting tools, system enhancements, and process changes.
  • Provide administrative and project support to Recruiting Leadership, including meeting coordination, team events, off-sites, and special projects.
  • Track project timelines, deliverables, and follow-up items to ensure priorities continue moving forward.
  • Maintain recruiting documentation, resources, and materials for Recruiting Leadership and the broader team.
  • Partner cross-functionally to support recruiting initiatives and ensure timely execution of recruiting priorities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Requisitions are opened, maintained, posted, and closed accurately and efficiently.
  • ATS data, candidate records, and recruiting documentation are accurate, complete, and up to date.
  • Interviews and on-site experiences are organized, seamless, and reflective of Petfolk's values.
  • Candidates, recruiters, and hiring teams receive timely, clear, and professional communication.
  • Interview feedback, reference checks, and other recruiting tasks are completed on time, with overdue items proactively followed up on and escalated when needed.
  • Externship and shadowing requests are managed efficiently, with accurate tracking and timely follow-through.
  • Recruiting processes and service-level expectations are consistently followed across the team.
  • Recruiting systems and workflows become increasingly organized, efficient, and reliable.
  • Opportunities for process improvement are identified and translated into practical solutions.
  • Recruiting Leadership has dependable administrative and project support that keeps priorities and deliverables moving forward.
  • Recruiters and hiring leaders are able to focus on strategic and candidate-facing work because day-to-day coordination and operational details are proactively managed.

Who You Are

  • You are highly organized and naturally keep track of details, deadlines, and follow-ups.
  • You have exceptional attention to detail and take pride in getting things right the first time.
  • You are proactive and do not wait for someone else to identify a problem before taking action.
  • You are an excellent communicator who can build positive relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • You are comfortable coordinating complex schedules and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • You are dependable and have a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.
  • You are service-oriented and care about creating a positive experience for both internal and external stakeholders.
  • You are comfortable working in systems and enjoy keeping information organized, accurate, and up to date.
  • You are a problem solver who looks beyond the immediate issue to understand how a process could work better.
  • You are comfortable following established processes while also identifying opportunities to improve them.
  • You are adaptable and can stay organized when priorities shift in a fast-growing environment.
  • You handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
  • You work well independently while also knowing when to communicate, escalate, or ask for help.
  • You bring a calm, solutions-oriented approach to a role where there are often many moving pieces at once.

Education & Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, recruiting coordination, HR operations, or a related field.
  • Experience working with an applicant tracking system and familiarity with recruiting systems and job boards.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex schedules, interviews, or other time-sensitive processes.
  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong focus on candidate and stakeholder experience.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively follow up on outstanding tasks and ensure commitments are completed.
  • Experience identifying process gaps and supporting improvements to workflows or systems.
  • Ability to maintain accurate and confidential candidate and recruiting information.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position, five days per week (Monday–Friday), requiring a dedicated workspace and reliable internet access. The role involves regular collaboration with the Recruiting team and cross-functional partners through video conferencing, email, messaging, and other recruiting and collaboration tools.

Approved states for hire:AL, AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, NY, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA

Travel Required

This position requires minimal travel, up to 10%, to Petfolk's headquarters for in-person meetings and to Pet Care Centers to familiarize yourself with projects and ensure timelines are met. Travel may also include veterinary conferences and local market events.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this position is $60,000-65,000, based on experience and qualifications.

Petfolk offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and continued growth of our team members.

About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Bengali
Type:Contract
Compensation:$13/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: find a publicly accessible Bengali PDF in an assigned document type, containing at least one multimodal element (images, tables, diagrams, or handwriting), and record where you obtained it.
  • Annotate structure: identify and bound every meaningful region of the page - document title, section heading, paragraph, list, table, figure, diagram, caption, formula, question, answer field - and assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: link each region to the figure or table it belongs to through a parent component identifier.
  • Transcribe faithfully: reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Bengali script, including handwritten content, flagging any region where the source is not legible.
  • Capture page metadata: language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work: every task is reviewed end to end by a second Bengali expert, and experienced annotators take on that review.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Bengali speaker with full command of the script, its diacritics, and its conjunct forms.
  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy; a single wrong diacritic is a defect.

This role is a remote role to be based in Portugal

About our company
Join Triptease — a high-growth SaaS company reshaping the future of hotel distribution. We help hoteliers take back control from OTAs by equipping them with the tools to grow direct bookings, protect margins, and strengthen guest loyalty.

Our platform combines proprietary hotel data, AI-driven marketing tools, and advanced pricing intelligence to give hoteliers an edge. With over £1 billion in direct revenue driven for clients annually and a global presence, this is your chance to be part of something big.

About our role

Ready to accelerate your career in Customer Success while making a real difference in the travel industry?

We're looking for a smart, driven and customer-obsessed individual to join our global CS team as a Customer Success Manager overseeing a group of our Mid Market accounts. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with 2–3 years of experience who's ready to take the next step, own relationships, and grow fast with a supportive team around them.

What you'll do

  • Own Your Portfolio — Manage ~25–35 hotel accounts. You'll be their go-to advisor, ensuring they're successful on the platform, achieving their goals, and sticking around long term.
  • Be Their Strategic Partner — Go beyond support. You'll help hoteliers improve their digital guest experience, boost direct bookings, and maximize revenue. Think of yourself as a consultant, not just a CSM.
  • Drive Impact with Data — Turn insights into action. Use our platform data to show the value your hotels are getting, and help them do more with it.
  • Grow and Renew Your Accounts — Own the commercial arc of every relationship. You'll convert trials into long-term contracts by making sure clients actually hit the expectations set at kick-off, uncover expansion opportunities as their needs grow (additional products, new properties, etc.), and lead renewal conversations and negotiations when the time comes. Retention and growth in your portfolio are yours to drive.
  • Build Real Relationships — You'll work with everyone from hotel marketing managers to GMs, and with our internal teams (Product, Sales, Engineering) to make sure your clients get what they need.
  • Level Up Their Success (and Yours) — Share best practices, lead training, gather feedback, and advocate for your hotels internally. We're big believers in customer-led growth.
  • Represent & Inspire — Encourage happy clients to become advocates at events, webinars, and in our hotelier community. Represent Triptease and your clients proudly.

Requirements

  • Experience: 2–3 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role, ideally within B2B SaaS. You've owned a portfolio and been accountable for whether those customers renewed.
  • Language: Native-level proficiency in English and Spanish (written and spoken) is essential. You must be able to communicate commercial and technical nuance clearly, and hold a confident conversation with a hotel's commercial leadership.
  • The "Automate Everything" Mindset: You are obsessed with efficiency and hate doing the same manual task twice. You approach work with this logic:
    • First time: You solve it and wonder if it will happen again.
    • Second time: You build a template or tool to automate the majority of the task.
    • Third time: You actively work to automate the process from start to finish so you never have to do it manually again.
  • In practice, this means the CSM who builds a reusable reporting template will always beat the one who rebuilds the same deck 30 times a quarter. We give you AI tools and the freedom to use them — we expect you to.
  • Commercial Ownership: You're comfortable owning renewal conversations, spotting risk early, and identifying growth opportunities in your accounts. You can talk about numbers — retention, revenue impact, ROI — without flinching.
  • Data Fluency: You can get into a spreadsheet or dashboard, find the story in the numbers, and build a recommendation from it. You don't just forward a report to a client; you tell them what it means and what to do next.
  • Technical Curiosity: You don't need to code, but you should be comfortable enough with web technologies to understand how our product sits on a hotel's website, what a tag manager does, and when an issue needs Support or Engineering. You're able to hold a credible conversation with a client's web agency rather than deferring every technical question.
  • Platform Proficiency: Confident using a modern CS platform (Vitally, Gainsight, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and support tooling such as Intercom. More importantly, you pick up new tools quickly and don't need a training course to get started.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can lead a call with a GM or commercial director, present performance clearly, and handle pushback without losing the room.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: You enjoy the investigation. When a hotel's performance dips, you want to understand why, not just report that it happened.
  • Adaptability: Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and new features ship frequently.
  • Self-Direction: You manage your own time, portfolio, and priorities across a distributed team without needing to be chased.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Professional proficiency in an additional European language (ex. French)
  • Experience in hospitality, travel tech, or a hotel commercial function (revenue management, e-commerce, distribution).
  • Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, or the metasearch and OTA landscape.
  • Experience using issue-tracking tools like Linear or JIRA.
  • Hands-on experience building with AI tools — automations, custom GPTs or Claude projects, scripts, no-code workflows.

Benefits

Our start-up culture means everybody's contribution matters and is celebrated. We set ourselves ambitious goals and are proud of our ability to deliver those through smart working. Pace. We’re growing. Get on board fast and be part of the journey. Having a real impact on an award-winning and fast-growing company.

  • 22 Days holiday
  • Working abroad for 4 weeks a year (within a -/+ 3 hours time zone of the UK)
  • Ben benefits* (£50 per month health and wellbeing budget) You can use this for gym membership, private healthcare, massages, therapy, cinema etc
  • Learning budget - £250 per calendar year *
  • Life Event leave (marriage, divorce, moving house, child’s first day at school, ceremony or graduation)
  • Make a Difference (volunteering) day

*Subject to passing probation

We do not require external agency support for the recruitment of this role. Thank you.

The ideal candidate does not need to be a Machine Learning Engineer or Data Scientist. Figma | WordPress | Webflow | Shopify | Squarespace | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Adobe XD | Sketch | WooCommerce | Google Lighthouse | PageSpeed Insights | GTmetrix | Google Analytics | Google Tag Manager | SEO Tools

raw.description:
Contracts Administrator – Contract Lifecycle Management & Legal Operations | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Contracts Administrator to manage the complete contract lifecycle — from intake and drafting through internal approvals, execution, storage, renewals, compliance tracking, and reporting.

This is a process-driven role for someone who understands that effective contract lifecycle management (CLM) is essential to reducing legal, financial, compliance, and operational risk.

You’ll work cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, Finance, Sales, Information Security, Compliance, and executive stakeholders to ensure agreements move efficiently while remaining accurate, properly approved, compliant, searchable, and audit-ready.

If you have hands-on contract administration or legal operations experience and thrive in structured, detail-heavy environments, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Contract Intake & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage contract requests including:
    • NDAs
    • Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
    • Statements of Work (SOWs)
    • Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)
    • Vendor agreements
    • Amendments
    • Renewals
  • Review incoming requests for completeness before initiating contract workflows
  • Confirm business terms, pricing, counterparties, jurisdictions, and compliance requirements
  • Route agreements through appropriate review and approval processes
  • Track contract status from intake through execution
  • Maintain execution timelines against established SLAs
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding reviews and approvals

Contract Drafting, Review & Redlining

  • Draft and format agreements using approved templates and clause libraries
  • Redline contracts using Microsoft Word Track Changes
  • Apply approved legal playbooks and fallback language
  • Identify and escalate non-standard provisions involving:
    • Indemnification
    • Limitation of liability
    • Intellectual property
    • Data privacy and security
    • Termination rights
    • Service-level agreements (SLAs)
  • Maintain clear records of contract deviations, approvals, and rationale
  • Ensure document versions remain accurate throughout negotiations

Approvals & Contract Governance

  • Coordinate contract reviews across:
    • Legal
    • Finance
    • Procurement
    • Information Security
    • Privacy
    • Leadership
  • Verify pricing, budget approvals, vendor documentation, and compliance requirements
  • Ensure agreements follow established approval matrices and governance policies
  • Track outstanding approvals and follow up with stakeholders to prevent unnecessary delays
  • Maintain appropriate documentation of approvals and exceptions

Execution & Contract Repository Management

  • Manage electronic signature workflows using platforms such as DocuSign or Adobe Sign
  • Confirm signer authority and signature requirements
  • Ensure fully executed agreements are properly stored
  • Maintain accurate records within CLM and contract management platforms such as:
    • Ironclad
    • Icertis
    • Agiloft
    • ContractWorks
    • Conga
    • SharePoint
  • Maintain contract metadata including:
    • Contract value
    • Effective and expiration dates
    • Renewal dates
    • Notice periods
    • Jurisdiction
    • Data-processing requirements
  • Ensure contracts remain searchable and accessible to authorized stakeholders

Renewals, Obligations & Compliance

  • Track:
    • Contract expiration dates
    • Renewal deadlines
    • Auto-renewal provisions
    • Notice periods
    • Pricing escalators
    • Contractual obligations
  • Maintain proactive reminders to prevent missed deadlines
  • Support compliance requirements involving:
    • GDPR
    • CCPA
    • HIPAA
    • PCI-DSS
    • Internal controls
  • Maintain complete approval, execution, and signature trails
  • Ensure contract records remain audit-ready

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Track and report on:
    • Contract cycle times
    • SLA adherence
    • Renewal pipelines
    • Clause deviations
    • Standard-term usage
  • Improve contract templates, clause libraries, workflows, and documentation
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive contract administration processes
  • Help develop scalable and self-service contracting workflows
  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements to contract operations

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in contracts administration, contract lifecycle management, legal operations, procurement operations, or a related function
  • Hands-on experience managing contracts throughout their lifecycle
  • Experience with CLM systems, contract repositories, and e-signature workflows
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Word Track Changes
    • Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
    • PDF editing tools
  • Working understanding of common contractual provisions, including:
    • Indemnification
    • Limitation of liability
    • Confidentiality
    • Intellectual property
    • Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)
    • Service-Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to coordinate multiple contracts and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience within SaaS, technology, healthcare, finance, or other regulated industries
  • Familiarity with vendor risk management and procurement workflows
  • Experience handling security questionnaires
  • Experience maintaining clause libraries and contract templates
  • Familiarity with legal playbooks and approval matrices
  • Exposure to:
    • GDPR
    • HIPAA
    • PCI-DSS
    • SOX
    • Similar compliance frameworks

Tools & Technology

Ironclad | Icertis | Agiloft | ContractWorks | Conga | SharePoint | DocuSign | Adobe Sign | Microsoft Word | Excel | Google Sheets | PDF Editing Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Catch small contractual and documentation inconsistencies quickly
  • Enjoy structured, process-heavy work
  • Can manage a high volume of agreements without sacrificing accuracy
  • Follow deadlines closely and proactively manage renewals
  • Communicate effectively across legal and non-legal teams
  • Understand when an issue can follow the standard process and when it requires escalation
  • Take ownership of contracts from initial request through execution and ongoing management
  • Keep documentation organized even while managing multiple competing priorities
  • Look for opportunities to make contracting workflows faster and more scalable

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing new contract requests and checking agreements awaiting internal approval or signature.

Throughout the day, you could draft or redline agreements, coordinate approvals with Legal or Finance, manage DocuSign workflows, update CLM records, monitor upcoming renewals, verify contractual obligations, and prepare contract reporting.

You’ll also work with stakeholders to resolve bottlenecks and continuously improve contracting processes, templates, and documentation.

In short: you ensure contracts move efficiently while remaining accurate, compliant, properly approved, searchable, and proactively managed throughout their lifecycle.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Contracts executed within SLA timelines
  • Zero missed renewal or notice deadlines
  • High contract metadata accuracy
  • Complete and audit-ready documentation
  • Reduced contract cycle times
  • Consistent adherence to approval workflows
  • Reduced non-standard clause deviations
  • Accurate renewal and obligation tracking
  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction with contract operations

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-impact role supporting critical business operations
  • Cross-functional exposure to Legal, Finance, Procurement, Compliance, Security, and leadership
  • Opportunity to improve and scale contract lifecycle processes
  • Strong ownership over contract governance and operational accuracy
  • Hands-on exposure to modern CLM and legal operations workflows
  • Fully remote environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Legal Operations Manager
    • Contract Manager
    • Procurement Operations
    • Commercial Operations
    • Contract Management Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Task – NDA Redlining Exercise / Contract Tracker Creation
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in contract administration, contract lifecycle management, or legal operations and enjoy managing detailed workflows, coordinating stakeholders, and keeping high-volume agreements accurate and organized, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of contracts from intake and redlining through execution, renewal, compliance tracking, and reporting.

raw.description:
Founded in 1999 in Vienna, the Qualysoft Group is a manufacturer-independent IT consulting and services company, which successfully provides support for its international customers with the aim of boosting their competitiveness and economic efficiency through innovative IT solutions.
Its focus is on financial services providers, telecommunications companies, the automotive industry and energy service providers. Over 400 employees in 6 subsidiaries work together to ensure state of the art solutions for our clients.
We are looking for new colleagues in Qualysoft teams for diverse projects providing continuous learning opportunities. Our common goal is to provide honesty, development and a stable background while getting to know the latest technologies. We are waiting for your application for the position below!

Project Overview

    The project focuses on the implementation of the DX platform (getdx.com) as a Proof of Concept (PoC), with a strong focus on objectively measuring the value generated by AI-assisted software development tools.

    AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, coding agents, and AI-assisted code review solutions are increasingly being adopted. However, their actual business value is currently difficult to measure reliably.

    The objective of the PoC is to assess whether AI adoption, usage intensity, development time savings, and the impact on quality and lead times can be reliably measured, integrated into existing systems, and used to support well-founded ROI, investment, and scaling decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the selection of pilot teams and the definition of an AI value measurement model.
  • Define measurement and success criteria covering AI adoption, usage intensity, time savings, lead time, quality impact, and ROI.
  • Set up and configure the DX platform, including SSO/identity integration and the permission model.
  • Integrate DX with existing GitLab, CI/CD, ticketing, and identity/SSO systems.
  • Integrate usage and telemetry data from the AI tools in use, including GitHub Copilot usage data / Copilot Metrics API.
  • Configure teams, hierarchies, and data models within the DX platform.
  • Set up and validate identity and team mapping across AI tools and delivery systems.
  • Link AI-related metrics with relevant cost data.
  • Set up the DX AI Measurement Framework surveys and system-side data collection.
  • Establish baseline measurements before and after the expansion of AI usage.
  • Analyze the impact of AI on quality-related metrics such as change failure rate, review effort, rework, and security findings, ensuring that AI value is not assessed solely in terms of speed.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and completeness, including error analysis and correction.
  • Implement technical requirements related to anonymization, aggregation, and data minimization.
  • Ensure a clear separation between AI usage measurement and individual performance measurement.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and exports to support results analysis and ROI assessment.
  • Identify the most effective AI use cases and key barriers to adoption based on the evaluation results.
  • Support the definition of enablement measures and the future scaling and license strategy.
  • Prepare technical documentation and estimate the effort and resources required for future scaling.

Why we think you will love working here:

With us you count as a person, our doors are always open.
We live the Qualysoft Team Spirit and stand for transparency!
Fresh wind and new ideas are welcome, because standstill is a foreign word at Qualysoft.

raw.description:
Business Introduction

At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Find out more:

Our approach to R&D

Position Summary

The purpose of the Global Monitoring & Site Engagement – Sr Director of Portfolio Execution – (RIRU) is to serve as the single accountable leader for therapeutic area execution within GMASE, translating R&D and therapeutic strategy into predictable, high-quality clinical delivery at scale.

Operating within the DevOps model, this role owns GMASE’s execution outcomes for the therapeutic area, ensuring that clinical delivery moves from fragmented, study-by-study execution to a consistent, data-driven, and continuously connected delivery system across programs, countries, and partners. The position is accountable for how GMASE plans, deploys, and optimizes resources, site engagement, monitoring approaches, and risk management to deliver the therapeutic area portfolio, not for setting GSK therapeutic strategy or scientific direction.

In close partnership with Disease Area Leaders (DALs), therapeutic area leadership, and DevOps counterparts, the position serves as GMASE’s execution lead, converting strategic intent into measurable improvements across GMASE’s value drivers — velocity, quality, predictability, expertise, and productivity. Through leadership of Global Program Leads and close coordination with Planning & Strategic Feasibility, GCSD, DS&M, Clinical Science, Regulatory, and external CRO partners, this position puts the DevOps operating model into practice within GMASE, positioning GMASE as the engine of continuous, AI-enabled evidence generation for the therapeutic area.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own therapeutic area execution for GMASE as a continuous, AI-enabled evidence generation engine, with full accountability for how the TA portfolio is delivered across programs, studies, countries, and partners in alignment with DevOps principles.

  • Provide GMASE’s execution and delivery-feasibility input into Disease Area Strategy Plans, acting as GMASE’s senior execution counterpart to Disease Area Leaders (DALs) and TA stakeholders, representing GMASE in TA-level execution discussions, trade-offs, and delivery commitments, while partnering closely on priorities and outcomes.

  • Establish GMASE TA-level execution alignment with Planning & Strategic Feasibility, ensuring portfolio priorities, commercial positioning, feasibility insights, and delivery strategies are coherently translated into executable, scalable plans.

  • Own GMASE TA-level portfolio performance oversight, including setting expectations, reviewing execution signals and evidence assurance data, identifying systemic risks and constraints, and driving timely resolution through structured escalation and cross-functional decision-making.

  • Provide senior leadership and talent stewardship for Global Program Leads (GPLs), including setting execution standards, strengthening decision quality, building leadership capability through fit-for-purpose onboarding and development, and holding accountability for performance; may include direct line management of GPLs.

  • Ensure appropriate site engagement for the TA, building GMASE’s site network as durable infrastructure rather than a study-by-study relationship — defining with key stakeholders and overseeing GMASE TA-wide site engagement and relationship strategies, including site tiering aligned to enterprise priorities, focusing GMASE focuses effort where it most impacts velocity, quality, and predictability.

  • Own GMASE’s execution governance for outsourced delivery within the TA, setting expectations with CRO partners, overseeing performance, and resolving delivery issues and escalations to ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes.

  • Ensure GMASE effective cross-functional execution governance, connecting GPLs and study teams to the appropriate decision-makers across GCSD, DS&M, Clinical Science, Regulatory, and other partners to remove systemic barriers and prevent fragmented delivery.

  • As a member of the GMASE Leadership Team, chair GMASE therapeutic area portfolio governance forums, including monthly TA reviews with Country Heads and functional partners, to drive performance transparency, resource alignment, and execution readiness, and contribute TA-level insight and recommendations to the Leadership Team.

  • Maximize the use of AI-enabled tools and workflows across GMASE TA execution and monitoring to accelerate trial timelines, reduce trial costs, and reduce time spent on manual tasks, continuously optimizing resource deployment and monitoring approaches based on actual utilization and delivery needs.

Why You?

Basic Qualification

We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Minimum of 10 years of pharmaceutical R&D or related industry experience.

  • Extensive (8+ years) leadership experience in clinical operations within the relevant therapeutic area.

  • Deep therapeutic area expertise and understanding of Respiratory/Immunology strategy, data, operational needs, and commercial positioning to enable aligned execution.

  • Experience owning end-to-end execution outcomes at portfolio or TA level, including accountability for delivery tradeoffs, risk resolution, and performance.

Preferred Qualification

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, PharmD, MD) in a relevant discipline.

  • Experience with real-world evidence, health economics and outcomes research, or epidemiology.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, resolve complex issues, and drive study and portfolio performance.

  • Strong global stakeholder management experience across GCSD, DS&M, Clinical Science, Regulatory, and country organizations.

  • Proven experience coaching and developing operational leaders.

  • Day-to-day fluency in using AI to accelerate trial timelines, improve data quality, evidence assurance, and reduce time spent on manual tasks.

  • Risk Based Quality Management knowledge.

  • Experience leading global portfolios or cross-region evidence programs.

  • Strong data fluency, including experience using dashboards and performance metrics to drive decisions.

  • Experience with vendor oversight and partnerships with CROs, academic networks or external investigators.

  • Demonstrated success delivering process improvements or digital-enabled transformation in evidence generation.

How to apply

If this role matches your experience and ambitions, please apply. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds who share our mission to get ahead of disease together. Tell us how your skills and experience will help deliver impact in this role.


Skills

Agile Thinking, Business Acumen, Clinical Development, Clinical Trial Designs, Communication, Creativity, Decision Making, Fostering Collaboration, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Influencing Without Authority, People Management, Pharmaceutical Industry, Project Management, Study DesignThe US annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges from $189,750 to $316,250. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. raw.description:
About Williamsburg Learning of Colorado

Williamsburg Academy of Colorado (WAC) is a tuition-free, full-time online public school serving students in grades 6–12 across the state. As part of Williamsburg Learning, we are committed to preparing promising students for meaningful lives as principled leaders through transformational learning experiences that spark curiosity, growth, and purpose.

At WAC, learning is both rigorous and flexible. Our model blends independent learning with live mentor support, empowering students to take ownership of their education while being deeply known, challenged, and supported. We focus on developing the whole student—academically, personally, and socially—through strong relationships, engaging content, and a vibrant community.

Across Williamsburg Learning, we live by our core values—Growth, Right Action, and a Culture of Belonging—and believe work should be meaningful and energizing. Our team is authentic, collaborative, and committed to doing what is best for students and for one another.

We also invest in our people, offering 100% paid health premiums for full-time employees (75% for families), a 100% 401(k) match up to 4%, PTO, and additional benefits that support well-being and growth. If our mission and culture resonate with you, we would love to have you on our team.

Position Summary

The Special Education Paraprofessional supports students with Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) in a virtual learning environment through instructional assistance, data collection, and mentorship. This role partners closely with Special Education Mentors to deliver personalized, high-quality learning experiences that promote student growth, independence, and confidence.

Essential Duties

1) Student Academic Support & Tutoring

  • Facilitate one-on-one and small group tutoring sessions aligned with student needs
  • Lead general education support sessions to reinforce core subject understanding
  • Help students stay on track with coursework and academic goals
  • Support diverse learners, including those needing additional academic intervention

2) Mentor/Classroom Support

  • Assist mentors during live sessions and asynchronous learning activities
  • Help manage student engagement and participation in virtual settings
  • Provide feedback to mentors on student progress, gaps, and wins

3) Learning Environment Management

  • Help maintain a structured, positive, and productive virtual classroom environment
  • Monitor student attendance, participation, and assignment completion
  • Reinforce behavioral and academic expectations aligned with WL’s mentor model

4) Administrative & Communication Support

  • Track student progress and maintain accurate documentation
  • Communicate with mentors and internal team members regarding student needs
  • Support scheduling and coordination of tutoring and support sessions

5) Student Relationship Development

  • Build supportive relationships that increase student engagement and ownership
  • Provide encouragement and accountability aligned with leadership development goals
  • Contribute to a strong sense of connection in a virtual environment

Non-Essential Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • At least 1 year of experience working with middle or high school students in an academic, tutoring, or support capacity
  • Ability to facilitate tutoring sessions and general education support sessions with guidance from mentors
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with students
  • Ability to stay organized and manage multiple students and responsibilities simultaneously
  • Comfort using technology and virtual learning platforms (e.g., video conferencing, Google Workspace)
  • Ability to follow instructional guidance and reinforce learning without serving as the primary instructor
  • Reliable internet access and ability to work in a fully remote environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience facilitating tutoring sessions or academic intervention programs
  • Experience supporting students in an online or blended learning environment
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS) such as Canvas, Google Classroom, or similar platforms
  • Experience working with diverse learners, including students with IEPs, 504 plans, or within an MTSS framework
  • Background in classical education, Socratic method, or discussion-based learning environments
  • Strong ability to build rapport and accountability with students in a virtual setting

Work Conditions

  • Full-time remote position
  • Must be available during regular business hours and peak enrollment cycles
  • Occasional off-hour virtual meetings may be required

Benefits

After meeting the eligibility requirements, benefits are available, including Health, 401(k) Retirement, Paid Holidays, and Paid Time Off.

Compensation & Hours:

  • $21.65 per hour
  • Part-Time, 20 per week

Williamsburg Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer

About Hammerspace, Inc.

Hammerspace delivers a Global Data Environment that spans data centers, AWS, Azure, and Google cloud infrastructure. With origins in Linux, NFS, Open standards, Flash and deep file system and data management technology leadership, Hammerspace delivers the world’s first and only solution to connect global users with their data and applications on any existing data center infrastructure or AWS, Azure, and Google cloud services.

About the Role

Hammerspace is seeking a senior, customer-facing Global Enterprise AI Sales Executive to accelerate adoption of the Hammerspace NVIDIA AI Data Platform (AIDP) with large enterprise customers worldwide. This is a quota-carrying specialist role that partners with regional Account Executives, NVIDIA, OEMs, systems integrators, and strategic partners to identify, develop, and close transformational AI data-platform opportunities.

The Executive will position Hammerspace as the data foundation for enterprise AI—making distributed, unstructured data across on-premises, cloud, edge, and heterogeneous storage environments accessible, governed, searchable, and ready for AI. The focus includes Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise search, agentic AI, AI copilots, knowledge management, research assistants, model development, inference, and AI data pipelines.

The successful candidate combines enterprise hunting discipline, executive-level business acumen, and credible AI-infrastructure fluency. They engage business-unit leaders, CIO/CTO organizations, AI Centers of Excellence, data and application teams, and ecosystem partners to move initiatives from discovery and business case through proof of value and production deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own global strategy, qualified pipeline, forecast accuracy, and revenue execution for Hammerspace Enterprise AI and NVIDIA AIDP opportunities.
  • Partner with regional Account Executives and sales leadership to prioritize target accounts, identify funded AI initiatives and buying centers, develop account plans, and orchestrate complex pursuits through close.
  • Create demand by engaging AI, data, application, and line-of-business leaders to uncover business problems, high-value data assets, and AI use cases where Hammerspace creates measurable outcomes.
  • Lead executive discovery, value-engineering conversations, workshops, solution briefings, and proof-of-value plans that connect data accessibility, governance, performance, and time-to-production to customer business priorities.
  • Position the combined value of Hammerspace, NVIDIA, and ecosystem solutions; articulate differentiation against alternative data-platform, AI-infrastructure, storage, and point-solution approaches.
  • Guide opportunities from concept through technical validation, RFI/RFP response, proposal development, commercial negotiation, and production adoption; coordinate sales, technical, services, product, and partner resources.
  • Work with NVIDIA field teams, solution architects, OEMs, cloud and technology partners, systems integrators, and channel partners to develop joint account strategies, co-sell motions, and demand-generation initiatives.
  • Build compelling customer business cases that define expected outcomes, data and infrastructure requirements, adoption path, risks, TCO/ROI considerations, and success measures from proof of concept to scaled production.
  • Maintain rigorous opportunity qualification, mutual action plans, competitive positioning, next steps, and executive-sponsor alignment using Hammerspace sales methodology and CRM discipline.
  • Develop repeatable global plays, qualification criteria, customer stories, and use-case messaging; enable sellers and partners on Enterprise AI positioning, discovery, competitive differentiation, and NVIDIA-related opportunities.
  • Represent Hammerspace at customer meetings, executive briefings, NVIDIA events, partner engagements, and industry conferences; communicate market feedback to product, marketing, and leadership teams.

Required Experience

-MUST BE BASED IN US.

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology sales, business development, or specialist-sales experience, with a sustained record of creating pipeline, closing complex opportunities, and exceeding revenue objectives.
  • Meaningful experience selling Enterprise Data Storage , AI, Generative AI, data platforms, AI infrastructure, GPU computing, enterprise storage, cloud, or adjacent solutions to large end-user organizations and individual business units.
  • Demonstrated ability to originate and advance new AI initiatives from early-stage discovery through proof of concept or proof of value, commercial close, and production deployment.
  • Strong working knowledge of enterprise AI concepts and architectures, including GenAI and LLMs, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, enterprise search, agentic AI, inference, model development, data pipelines, GPUs, and AI infrastructure.
  • Proven success navigating multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving business sponsors, technical evaluators, procurement, security, legal, and executive decision-makers.
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into a business case with measurable value, including productivity, risk reduction, data access, speed to insight, operational efficiency, and time to production.
  • Experience collaborating in a matrixed specialist-sales model with field Account Executives, sales engineers, professional services, marketing, product teams, and channel or alliance partners.
  • Exceptional executive communication, discovery, presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and account-planning skills.
  • Ability to operate independently across global geographies, coordinate virtual pursuit teams, and travel internationally as required.

Preferred Background

Experience selling solutions involving one or more of the following is highly desirable:

  • NVIDIA Enterprise AI technologies and the NVIDIA field and partner ecosystem
  • Generative AI, Large Language Models, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • AI infrastructure, GPU computing, HPC, AI storage, or AI development and inference platforms
  • Enterprise data platforms, unstructured data management, data discovery, governance, vector databases, semantic search, or enterprise search
  • Joint go-to-market development with cloud providers, OEMs, systems integrators, resellers, or strategic technology partners
  • Structured enterprise sales methodologies and value-selling disciplines, including qualification, mutual action planning, and executive business-case development

The Opportunity

Enterprise AI programs often stall because the data that creates their value remains fragmented across storage systems, clouds, locations, and organizational silos. Hammerspace enables customers to bring AI to their data—without replacing existing storage infrastructure or undertaking massive data migrations. In partnership with NVIDIA and the broader ecosystem, Hammerspace helps enterprises discover, organize, access, govern, and use distributed data for the next generation of AI applications.

The Global Enterprise AI Sales Executive will turn this differentiated opportunity into a scalable global business, shaping strategic customer outcomes and establishing Hammerspace as the AI data platform of choice for the

To the extent required by state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $300,000-350,000 OTE.Actual compensation will be determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional/education experience, skills/abilities, internal equity, and budgetary considerations. In addition, Hammerspace offers a broad range of health plans for medical, dental, vision, life and disability. We also offer 401k plans and flexible time off. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

Hammerspace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status, or national origin or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law.

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies:
Agencies are hereby specifically directed not to contact Hammerspace employees directly in an attempt to present candidates. To protect the interests of all parties, Hammerspace will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to Hammerspace will be considered Hammerspace property. Hammerspace will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. About the role

Join us in shaping the technology backbone of our enterprise platforms, where front-end applications, APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure come together to power business-critical systems. As our Senior Full-Stack Solutions Architect, you'll define target-state architecture, guide modernization efforts, and stay hands-on enough to validate designs, review implementation, and resolve complex production issues. If you love connecting business strategy to real technical execution across the full stack, we want to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Own solution architecture across UI, backend services, APIs/integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure, and security, translating business needs into current-state, transition-state, and target-state designs
  • Design and guide modernization of full-stack applications built on PHP (7/8) with MVC or singleton frameworks, and Vue.js (2 or 3) on the front end
  • Architect and develop RESTful APIs following OpenAPI standards, defining integration, authentication, versioning, and error-handling practices
  • Design data and caching strategies using MongoDB and Redis, including schema design, performance, replication, and backup/restore
  • Design and deploy secure, scalable AWS architectures using EC2 and ECS, with sound networking and IAM practices, containerized via Docker
  • Establish observability, high-availability, and disaster-recovery patterns, and lead investigations into performance, security, and integration issues
  • Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders

What you bring

  • 12+ years in software/platform engineering, including 5+ years leading solution or enterprise architecture
  • Strong hands-on experience with PHP 7/8 using an MVC or singleton framework, plus a modern JavaScript framework - Vue.js 2 or 3 required
  • Proven experience building and integrating RESTful APIs to OpenAPI standards
  • Practical experience with MongoDB and Redis, including performance, replication, and data integrity considerations
  • Core AWS knowledge (EC2, ECS), networking for application deployment, IAM, and Docker/container platforms
  • Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and explain trade-offs, risks, and decisions to technical and nontechnical audiences alike
  • Proven judgment balancing strategic architecture with incremental delivery, legacy constraints, and operational realities

Nice to have

  • Agentic AI experience
  • Architecture or cloud certifications (TOGAF, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent)
  • Experience modernizing monolithic platforms into modular, API-led, containerized, or cloud-native systems
  • Performance testing/capacity engineering experience (e.g., JMeter)

VIRTUAL NURSE CLINICAL NURSE

The Virtual Nurse will deliver exemplary nursing care virtually, in collaboration with the care team. This virtual care will be provided in collaboration with the care team to inpatients at Duke University Hospital, Duke Regional Hospital, Duke Raleigh Hospital, and Duke Lake Norman Hospital. This position will provide nursing care in a virtual setting in accordance with the medical and nursing plans of care and established policies and procedures accordance with the scope of the RN as defined by the North Carolina Board of Nursing.

Supports nursing tasks virtually as admission questionnaires, discharge education, patient education, nurse mentoring, and other tasks as needed. This care will be provided using the EMR and telehealth technology using two-way audio and video to provide patient care. The virtual nurse will practice within the guidelines of the standards of nursing care to inpatient acute level patient populations from a remote Virtual Care Center in collaboration with the bedside patient care team.

Utilizes patient EMR to support patient admission, education, discharge planning, identify and interpret trends and acute changes in patient physiology, monitor compliance of care bundles and protocols, and collaborates with the bedside multidisciplinary health care team using effective communication and clinical decision-making skills. Serves as a resource for inpatient support for novice nurses who are developing their clinical competencies and decision-making skills. Provides guidance and assistance while giving additional support in the assessment, evaluation, and intervention responsibilities with patients.

  • Supports the bedside staff for a large patient ratio to monitor comprehensive compliance of best practice protocols and care bundles aimed at reduction of Mortality, Length of Stay, Hospital Readmissions, and Patient Safety Events.
  • Provides patient education and support virtually including verbal and written instructions. Assess the patient/family ability to receive education and uses appropriate tools and techniques.

Skilled and comfortable with various technologies to coordinate patient care, including multiple software applications, computerized clinical guidelines, specialized telephone technology, video and image transmission, and more.

  • Provides consultation and second opinion virtually to assist with clinical decision making, including managing inpatient patients whose condition may be deteriorating or who may require transfer to a higher level of care. Assists nurses with an appropriate plan of care related to a change of condition.
  • Ability to work in a constant state of alertness and in a safe manner is an essential function of this job.
  • Virtually support the plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures in collaboration with the care nurse. Use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care in collaboration with the care nurse based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care.

  • Identifying appropriate patients for Remote Safety Observation (RSO) Placement. Supporting care nurse with monitoring of unit dashboard and notifying the nurse with tasks needing attention.
  • Act as Charge Nurse and Preceptor in oversite of RSO staff and escalating to unit leadership when appropriate.
  • Act as preceptor and support the development of other staff and formal learners.
  • Participate in the identification of clinical or operational performance improvement opportunities and in performance improvement activities.
  • Perform other related duties incidental to the work described herein

Experience:

Preceptor and Charge Nurse Experience is required.
Minimum Requirements 3-5 years appropriate inpatient clinical experience is required.
Preferred Requirements 5-10 + year’s appropriate inpatient clinical experience is required.At a manager's discretion, employees with less than the above experience who are exceptional performers may be eligible for this level.

Degrees, Licensure, and/or Certification: Must have current or compact RN licensure in the state of North Carolina. BLS required.

Education:

  • Graduation from an accredited Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing (or higher) OR Associate's Degree in Nursing OR Nursing Diploma program.
  • Twelve months of appropriate clinical experience is required for Experienced Registered Nurses.

  • Ability to excel with computer technology and learn new software programs
  • Ability to troubleshoot computer technology
  • Ability to assess nursing needs of acute and chronically ill patients and their families using virtual technology
  • Ability to independently seek out resources and work collaboratively
  • Ability to excel in communication skills through asynchronous technology and telephone
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships in the virtual environment
  • Ability to communicate clearly with patients, families, visitors, healthcare team, physicians, administrators, leadership and others through virtual technology

  • Able to document and communicate pertinent information using computer and/or paper documentation tools

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. You'll rethink what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy enough that teams choose to adopt it.

  • Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy.
  • Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions.
  • Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language.
  • Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, fed straight back into the platform.

What you’ll do

  • Own the technical thesis for how GitLab validates software when an agent is the author, and turn it into an architecture the team can build against.
  • Prototype the hard parts by building early versions of feedback mechanisms that catch the gap between passing tests and working software, proving what works before the team scales it.
  • Develop approaches for GitLab's primary stacks, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, under one shared definition of "trusted," while allowing the right technique to differ by language.
  • Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to adopt these approaches, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those findings to improve the platform.
  • Set technical direction the team can build on, review designs, and help teammates grow their technical judgment.

What you’ll bring

  • Deep, current, hands-on experience building real software with artificial intelligence agents, ideally across more than one language, and a clear understanding of why agent output can pass tests yet fail in production.
  • A strong point of view on the validation gap and concrete ideas for closing it, backed by approaches you've built or tried.
  • The technical range to design systems rather than tune a single framework, and the judgment to know when a solution should be general or language-specific.
  • You prototype to learn, and you ship.
  • The ability to influence engineers across an organization without formal authority through working code and sound reasoning.
  • Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.
  • Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency.

This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We aren't looking for depth in a particular testing framework. We're looking for someone who has built with agents, experienced the validation gap firsthand, and wants to solve it.

About the team

The Trusted Agentic Development team is part of GitLab's Developer Experience group. We build platforms and practices that help GitLab engineers validate agent-generated software with confidence. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt.
