raw.description:
About The Team

The ALX Community Experience team is a high-performing, impact-driven team that thrives on collaboration and scale. We embrace innovation, test new ideas, and go the extra mile to deliver meaningful results and experiences for our Learners and Alumni. Grounded in data and fueled by solutions, we hold ourselves and each other accountable to exceptionally high standards, enabling us to consistently grow and strengthen the ALX Community across markets.

Do you excel in fast-paced environments where ambitious goals drive your work? Do you bring an analytical mindset that helps you identify trends, improve systems, and translate insights into action? Can you turn a newsletter or an eHub post into something members actually stop to read? Are you a natural relationship-builder who can foster trust and collaboration across regions and teams? Are you ready to roll up your sleeves, adapt quickly, and do whatever it takes to ensure the success of our Community?

If so, then this could be the role for you.

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

  • Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.
  • Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.
  • Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey.

Our impact thus far:

  • 205k+ learners since 2021
  • 117k youth in work
  • 13k youth starting own ventures
  • 66k youth in jobs through entrepreneurship

Visit our website to learn more about our digital revolution.

Role Summary

As the Community Program Specialist, you'll embed community across the ALX talent journey, from selection and recruitment through learning, transition, and alumni engagement. You'll own ALX's virtual community presence, including eHub, along with the community's newsletters and communications, working cross-functionally with Community Managers, Marketing, Learning, and other teams to deliver one consistent, member-driven experience, in person and online.

Specific Responsibilities

Program Management

  • Design and implement strategies to embed community at every stage of the ALX talent journey (selection, recruitment, learning, transition, alumni).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Recruitment, Learning, Alumni) to ensure community-driven approaches are integrated into their workflows.
  • Develop frameworks and toolkits/playbooks to support Regions in driving community initiatives.

Community Integration

  • Ensure the community is member-led and city-driven, with central support for strategy, frameworks, and resource allocation.
  • Implement one ALX community: bring learners and alumni into a single, unified community rather than treating them as separate audiences, so the transition from learner to alumnus feels continuous, not like leaving one group to join another.

Online Community & Digital Engagement (eHub)

  • Own and manage eHub, the ALX virtual community platform, as the digital home for learners and alumni, keeping it active, well-moderated, and useful.
  • Set up and maintain the eHub structure (groups, channels, resources) so it matches the talent journey and supports member needs at every stage.
  • Drive day-to-day engagement on eHub: start discussions, welcome new members, surface relevant content, and moderate conversations in line with community guidelines.
  • Track and report on eHub engagement metrics (active users, posts, response times, sentiment) and use the data to improve the platform over time.
  • Work with stakeholders so that eHub complements other member touchpoints instead of duplicating them.
  • Manage eHub interest groups and support interest group leaders to manage the spaces as well as programming.

Newsletters & Communications

  • Plan, write, and send monthly community newsletters that inform and engage members.
  • Own the community communications calendar, keeping messaging timely, consistent, and on-brand across email, eHub, and other member channels.
  • Write and distribute announcements for community events, champion initiatives, campaigns , and key organizational updates.
  • Track newsletter and communication performance (open rates, click-through, engagement) and adjust content and cadence to improve reach and impact.
  • Keep a consistent community voice and brand across all written and digital touchpoints.

Metrics & Reporting

  • Help define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of community integration across the talent journey, including eHub and communications performance.
  • Regularly report on community engagement, member satisfaction, and program impact to stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with city leads, members, and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and collaboration.
  • Act as the central point of contact for community-related initiatives and make sure information flows smoothly across the organization.

Enablement & Amplification

  • Curate and share member-generated content and success stories, through eHub, newsletters, and other channels, to engage the broader community.
  • Enable cities to drive local engagement, share learnings, and build communities of practice.

Skill Requirements-Must Have

  • 3-4 years of experience in community management, social/digital media, internal comms, or program management, ideally in education, tech, or a membership-based organization.
  • Hands-on experience running an online community platform (e.g. Discourse, Circle, Slack, Discord, or similar) at scale.
  • Proven ability to plan and write newsletters and other member communications that people actually read, with a consistent, on-brand voice.
  • Comfortable working with email/newsletter tools (e.g. Mailchimp, HubSpot, or similar) and basic engagement analytics.
  • Experience planning and running community events, whether virtual, in-person, or hybrid.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to adapt tone and message across channels and audiences.
  • Comfortable working with data: tracking engagement metrics, spotting trends, and turning insights into action.
  • Ability to work with city leads, members, and cross-functional teams across multiple locations, including virtually.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment with a hands-on approach.

Skill Requirements – Nice To Have

  • Experience moderating or building online communities from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with community-led growth, ambassador, or referral programs.
  • Experience with graphic or content tools (e.g. Canva) to support newsletters and social content.
  • Knowledge of behavioural psychology or engagement strategies to improve retention and participation.

Due to the considerable amount of virtual working and interaction with colleagues and customers in different physical locations internationally, it is essential that the successful applicant has the drive and ethic to succeed working in small teams physically but in larger efforts virtually. Self-drive to communicate constantly using web collaboration and video conferencing is essential. As an employee, you will be encouraged to continually develop your capability & attain certifications to reflect your growth as an individual.

Employment Type

This role is a Full-time position

As this is a fully remote role, the successful applicant should be highly self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a digital-first environment. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams using tools such as Zoom, Slack, and Gmail. Strong communication is essential, and success in this role will depend on your ability to stay connected, work proactively, and take initiative.

Digital Marketing Manager

Full-Time | Exempt | Remote - Eastern or Central Time Zone Candidates Only

Help Transform Education Through Data-Driven Marketing

At Instructional Empowerment, our mission is bold: to end generational poverty and eliminate achievement gaps through redesigned rigorous Tier 1 instruction that ensures deeper learning for ALL students.

Every day, we partner with school districts across the country to improve teaching and learning by equipping educators with proven instructional frameworks that drive meaningful student outcomes.

We're seeking a strategic, data-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead our digital marketing efforts and build a high-performing marketing engine that increases awareness, engagement, and qualified pipeline among K–12 education leaders. "This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide ownership of digital marketing strategy and execution."

This role owns the strategy, execution, and optimization of our digital marketing ecosystem—including paid media, marketing automation, website optimization, analytics, and marketing technology. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and Executive Leadership to generate measurable business growth while helping educators access solutions that transform teaching and learning.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys using technology and analytics to solve complex marketing challenges.

What You'll Do

Digital Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute integrated digital marketing strategies that drive qualified leads and measurable pipeline growth.
  • Plan and manage multi-channel marketing campaigns across paid media, email, webinars, events, website content, and landing pages.
  • Build campaigns that engage prospective customers throughout every stage of the buyer journey.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities into compelling, customer-focused messaging and campaign positioning.
  • Align marketing initiatives with organizational growth objectives and business development priorities.

Paid Media & Digital Marketing

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
  • Develop audience targeting strategies focused on superintendents, district leaders, principals, instructional leaders, and classroom educators.
  • Manage campaign budgets while maximizing return on advertising spend (ROAS).
  • Continuously test and optimize ad creative, messaging, landing pages, and audience segmentation to improve campaign performance and conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & HubSpot Administration

  • Serve as the organization's primary HubSpot administrator.
  • Manage CRM data integrity, segmentation, lead scoring, workflows, forms, landing pages, dashboards, and marketing automation.
  • Develop and optimize lead nurturing programs that move prospects through the marketing and sales funnel.
  • Support efficient lead lifecycle management and marketing-to-sales handoff processes.

Marketing Technology, Analytics & Reporting

  • Own the implementation and optimization of marketing tracking infrastructure using Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
  • Ensure accurate measurement of website activity, campaign performance, attribution, and conversion events.
  • Maintain marketing integrations between HubSpot and Salesforce to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Build dashboards and executive reports that provide visibility into campaign performance, marketing-sourced pipeline, and return on investment.
  • Analyze marketing data and provide actionable recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and business results.

Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Manage website conversion strategies, including landing page development, testing, and optimization.
  • Conduct A/B testing to improve conversion rates and lead generation performance.
  • Support SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and website user experience initiatives that increase organic visibility and engagement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and Executive Leadership to ensure alignment across marketing initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Sales Leadership to improve lead quality, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and marketing contribution.
  • Support product launches, go-to-market initiatives, and strategic marketing campaigns.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • 6–8 years of progressive experience in digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing within a B2B organization.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated demand generation programs that generate qualified leads and measurable pipeline growth.
  • Extensive hands-on experience administering HubSpot Marketing Hub, including workflows, lead scoring, segmentation, reporting, and marketing automation.
  • Proven experience managing paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and other digital advertising platforms.
  • Strong experience implementing and managing Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), conversion tracking, and marketing attribution.
  • Experience working with Salesforce CRM and managing marketing technology integrations.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data, identify opportunities, and translate insights into business recommendations.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing products or services to K–12 school districts, education leaders, or other public-sector audiences.
  • Expertise in conversion rate optimization (CRO), SEO, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).
  • Experience supporting product launches and go-to-market initiatives.
  • HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Ads, or Google Analytics certifications.
  • Experience promoting webinars, conferences, and virtual events.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you'll help us achieve measurable business impact by:

  • Increasing qualified lead generation and marketing-sourced pipeline.
  • Improving campaign conversion rates while reducing cost per lead.
  • Building scalable marketing automation and lead nurturing programs.
  • Delivering accurate attribution and executive reporting that informs business decisions.
  • Strengthening alignment between Marketing and Sales to improve lead quality and pipeline velocity.
  • Growing awareness and engagement among K–12 district and school leaders.

Why Join Instructional Empowerment?

At Instructional Empowerment, your work matters. Every marketing campaign you launch and every lead you generate helps connect educators with solutions that improve teaching and learning for students across the country.
A Benefits Package Designed Around Your Well-Being

  • Multiple medical plan options, including a 100% employer-paid health plan
  • HSA and FSA options available to save for medical expenses, with employer-funded HSA contributions for those participating in eligible healthcare plans
  • Company-paid dental, vision, life, STD, and LTD coverage
  • 15 days of PTO available in your first year of employment
  • 8 paid holidays, plus 2 floating holidays
  • 401(k) with a 4% company match
  • Salary range $90,000-$95,000

If you're looking for a role where you can combine your expertise in digital marketing, automation, analytics, and technology with a mission that truly makes a difference, we encourage you to apply.

RemotePass exists because talent is distributed equally, but opportunity is not. Backed by EBRD and trusted by 800+ companies across 150+ countries, RemotePass is the platform that gives businesses the infrastructure to hire anyone, anywhere — and gives workers in emerging markets the financial tools and global access they deserve.

RemotePass is the only platform that combines Employer of Record, contractor management, direct employment, and corporate spend cards in a single product — rated 4.8/5 on G2, trusted by Spotify, Logitech, and Deloitte, and operating across 150+ countries. We are backed by leading global investors, including Oraseya Capital, Endeavor Catalyst, Khwarizmi Ventures, Flyer One Ventures, Access Bridge Ventures, A15, Swiss Founders Fund, and Plug & Play.

The role

As RemotePass scales, we are adding a Compliance Operations Lead to strengthen the bridge between our Head of Compliance, Operations, and the analyst team. This person will handle ambiguous cases, keep day-to-day execution moving, and ensure compliance decisions are consistent, well-documented, and defensible.

This role is flexible by design. If you want to manage the analyst team directly, we're open to that. If you'd rather come in as a senior individual contributor who's simply the team's first point of escalation, that works too — we'll shape the role around the right person. What matters more than the org chart is the operational judgment: the ability to look at an incomplete document set, a vague business description, or an unusual payment pattern, and know exactly what to do with it.

What you'll do

  • Be the first escalation point for complex KYB, KYC, and enhanced due diligence cases, before anything reaches the Head of Compliance
  • Review and QA analyst decisions — risk ratings, evidence, disposition notes — to make sure they're complete and defensible
  • Set and track team SLAs and KPIs: case aging, turnaround times, QA findings, rework rates
  • Build and maintain SOPs, escalation templates, and case documentation standards as the team scales
  • Manage sanctions, PEP, and adverse media escalations, including false-positive review and evidence retention
  • Support transaction monitoring — spotting unusual payout patterns, rapid onboarding, or high-risk activity
  • Maintain our compliance evidence register and issue/remediation tracker for audits and partner reviews
  • Coordinate with Customer Success and Operations so client-facing compliance requests stay clear and commercially practical
  • Report on compliance operations to our Head of Compliance and COO

Requirements

  • 5+ years in compliance operations, AML/financial crime, sanctions, or payments compliance — ideally with experience at a licensed money transmitter, payment institution, bank, PSP, fintech, card/spend platform, marketplace, or other regulated financial services environment.
  • Comfortable making calls on ambiguous cases: incomplete documents, unclear business activity, or elevated payment partner risk
  • Able to clearly separate a documentation gap from real risk from something that needs to go straight to the Head of Compliance
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or QA'ing analysts is a strong plus — not required
  • Strong written communication: case notes, escalation summaries, and partner responses that hold up under scrutiny
  • CAMS or CFCS certification is a plus
  • Arabic fluency is a strong plus, not a requirement

Benefits

  • Remote-First Culture: We don't just sell remote work; we live it. Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Hyper-Growth: Be part of a company that is consistently recognized for its rapid expansion and innovation.
  • Inclusion Matters: We are committed to building a diverse team. We value different perspectives and empower every individual to bring their authentic self to work.

POSITION TITLE: Director, Fiancial Reporting and Accounting Policy

Position Summary

The Director, Financial Reporting is responsible for leading the preparation and delivery of accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting for a publicly traded mortgage company. This role is responsible for SEC Reporting, regulatory filings and Accounting Policy.

The Director serves as a key leader within the Finance organization, partnering closely with Accounting Operations, Treasury, Capital Markets, Servicing, Originations, FP&A, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and External Audit teams to support high-quality financial reporting, internal controls, and strategic business initiatives.

This position plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity of the company’s financial statements, evaluating complex transactions,

Job Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the preparation and review of quarterly and annual SEC filings, including Forms 10-Q, 10-K, 8-K disclosures and supporting the earnings release process

  • Oversee the preparation and submission of recurring filings required by federal and state regulators, GSEs, warehouse lenders, investors, and other stakeholders.

  • Research and document accounting conclusions for complex accounting matters, including mortgage servicing rights, securitizations, debt transactions, acquisitions, fair value measurements, and other strategic transactions and business initiatives. .

  • Prepare and oversee statutory reporting for subsidiaries.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors, legal counsel, regulators, and internal stakeholders on financial reporting matters.

  • Partner with Internal Audit, SOX Compliance, Accounting Operations, and operational teams to maintain effective internal controls over financial reporting, including control documentation, testing support, remediation activities, and audit requests.

  • Lead the preparation of executive-level financial reporting packages, board support materials, earnings support, and other management reporting deliverables.

  • Drive process improvement, standardization, and automation initiatives across financial reporting processes to increase reporting accuracy, efficiency, scalability, and governance.

  • Promote best practices for reporting documentation, review procedures, data integrity, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop financial reporting professionals, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and professional development plans.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships with Accounting Operations, Treasury, Capital Markets, Servicing, Originations, FP&A, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Investor Relations, Tax, and External Audit teams

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must have the following education and/or experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.

  • CPA or equivalent required.

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience.

  • Minimum 3-5 years of leadership experience managing accounting or financial reporting teams.

  • Public company and SEC reporting experience required.

  • Mortgage banking, financial services, banking, or specialty finance industry experience strongly preferred.

  • Big 4 public accounting experience preferred.

  • Advanced knowledge of U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements and demonstrated ability to research and resolve complex accounting matters.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare financial statement disclosures and present complex information clearly and concisely to senior leaders.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications; experience with Oracle, Workiva Wdesk, SEC reporting software, or similar financial reporting platforms preferred

Training / Licensing Requirements:

  • Must pass the Company’s Background Screening process prior to beginning employment. Additionally, as a condition of employment, you may be required to pass client-specific background check requirements or Federal/State licensing requirements, if applicable.

  • The salary range for this position is expected to be $ 165k-190k per year, depending on geographic location, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.This position is also eligible for Bonus based on performance and subject to the terms of the company's applicable plans.

Sobre a Zippi

Estamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.

Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito, permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa consistente para suas operações.

Desde o nosso lançamento, há quatro anos, alcançamos a lucratividade e vivemos um período de crescimento exponencial. Até hoje, já concedemos mais de R$ 10 bilhões em crédito para micro e pequenos negócios em todo o Brasil. Estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de capital de giro no mercado brasileiro de MPBs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 3,5 trilhões por ano. Assim como os cartões de crédito transformaram o consumo, a Zippi está redefinindo a forma como os pequenos negócios gerenciam seu fluxo de caixa — com acesso instantâneo, integração fluida e soluções construídas para necessidades reais do dia a dia.

Nosso sucesso é impulsionado por uma abordagem altamente automatizada e baseada em dados. Construímos uma infraestrutura tecnológica avançada, capaz de processar grandes volumes de dados de pagamentos e crédito, o que nos permite realizar a análise de risco, a liberação e a cobrança de crédito em escala, mantendo unit economics sólidos. Gerenciamos todo o ciclo de crédito internamente, alavancando ciência de dados de ponta para tomar decisões em tempo real com alto nível de precisão.

Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, formamos um time de tecnologia de calibre global focado em construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar. Se você busca a oportunidade de gerar impacto real em uma causa que vale a pena, em uma das startups que mais crescem em mercados emergentes, atuando em uma oportunidade multibilionária — a Zippi é o lugar certo para você.

Sobre o Time

Growth é a grande alavanca para materializar a ambição da Zippi de dobrar de tamanho novamente em 2026, depois de já ter dobrado em 2025. Dentro de Growth, Mídia Paga é um dos motores centrais de aquisição, operando hoje três canais ativos - Meta, Google e TikTok - com espaço para aprofundar cada um deles e abrir novas frentes.

Essa é uma cadeira para dar à operação analítica de mídia paga a dedicação e o rigor que o momento de hipercrescimento exige: mais testes, mais leitura de dados, mais velocidade de iteração, cada vez mais suportados por agentes de IA. Você vai atuar em parceria próxima com quem já toca essa operação, dividindo a responsabilidade em pé de igualdade e com autonomia para assumir canais próprios desde o início.

Sua Missão

  1. Ownership de Canais: assumir a operação analítica de canais de mídia paga (Meta, Google, TikTok) de ponta a ponta, leitura de performance, hipóteses de teste e rotina de otimização, respondendo por eficiência (pCAC/ROAS) e volume.
  2. Expansão para Novas Frentes: estruturar e liderar o setup analítico de novos canais, como Kwai e DSPs, trazendo benchmarks de fora para acelerar decisões e abrir frentes que hoje ficam de lado por falta de capacidade dedicada.
  3. Automação e IA Aplicada: construir e evoluir agentes de IA e automações, relatórios recorrentes, alertas de anomalia, puxadas de dados, que acelerem a análise e a operação de mídia paga, incluindo ferramentas internas de growth já em uso.
  4. Elevação de Repertório: trazer práticas e frameworks de User Acquisition de mercado, estrutura de conta, medição e incrementalidade, ciclo de criativos, que se tornem padrão na forma como a Zippi opera mídia paga.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência em User Acquisition e Mídia Paga: track record real gerindo budget relevante em pelo menos um canal principal (Meta, Google, TikTok ou DSPs), com histórico de escalar investimento mantendo eficiência.
  • Raciocínio quantitativo e domínio de métricas de aquisição: fluência em CAC/pCAC, ROAS, CPM e CVR por etapa de funil, com autonomia para investigar performance em planilhas e SQL (ou ferramentas de BI) sem depender de terceiros.
  • Fluência prática em IA: usa IA ativamente no dia a dia e tem interesse genuíno em construir agentes e automações que acelerem análise e operação.
  • Ownership de ponta a ponta: disposição para assumir um canal com autonomia, propor formato e tocar rotina operacional em um ambiente ainda em construção.
  • Comunicação e repertório de mercado: traduz análise em recomendação clara, defende hipóteses com dados e traz benchmarks e provocações de fora, sem soberba.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência abrindo canais novos (Kwai, DSPs, programática) do zero;
  • Vivência com medição/incrementalidade (geo tests, MMM, holdouts) e com MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust);
  • Experiência com automações (n8n, Zapier), scripts (Python) ou construção de agentes de IA.

Por que vir para a Zippi

  • Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar: nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente 22 milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções.
  • Ownership e construção desde o primeiro dia: como um early team member, você terá papel essencial na criação da área de crescimento de uma startup lucrativa, bem financiada e apoiada por investidores de renome como Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Globo Ventures e Volpe Capital.
  • Aprendizado acelerado com gente boa: aqui você terá a oportunidade de se envolver em projetos estratégicos e enfrentar desafios complexos ao lado de fundadores e operadores de fintechs de ponta. Nossos times são colaborativos, atuam com autonomia e carregam um alto grau de responsabilidade.

O que você pode esperar da gente

  • Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado;
  • Learning Budget anual;
  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi para você e para dependentes até 18 anos. Para cônjuges e companheiros(as), cobrimos 50% da mensalidade;
  • Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos;
  • Vale-refeição no Caju;
  • Férias flexíveis;
  • Wellhub e Zenklub;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto.

raw.description:
SHAZAM recognizes that financial institutions build better communities, and this drives our passion to strengthen financial institutions. We are a trusted partner to our valued customers providing answers, choice, and innovation with an impeccable level of customer service – a level unmatched in the industry.

And here’s the best part - we’re a national company that offers a small-company feel, a cultural balance that’s hard to come by but very real at SHAZAM. Your growth and development are top priorities and you’ll be surrounded by talented individuals and postured to make a real difference in the company. As a team member at SHAZAM, you’ll be an essential part of our mission as we work together strengthening financial institutions.

This is a remote position with up to 50% travel. Ideal candidates would live in the Midwest.

What we're looking for:

The Client Executive, EFT Solutions, plays a pivotal role in managing and expanding client relationships within the electronic funds transfer (EFT) sector of the business services industry. This position is responsible for delivering tailored EFT solutions that meet client needs while ensuring compliance with industry regulations and company standards. The role requires a strategic approach to client engagement, focusing on understanding client business models and financial processes to recommend optimal EFT products and services. The Client Executive will collaborate closely with internal teams such as sales, product development, and customer support to ensure seamless service delivery and client satisfaction. Ultimately, this role aims to drive revenue growth and enhance client retention by providing exceptional service and innovative EFT solutions in a remote work environment.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients to understand their EFT needs and business objectives.
  • Present and demonstrate EFT solutions tailored to client requirements, ensuring alignment with regulatory and compliance standards.
  • Develop and present complex pricing proposals and competitive analyses for financial institutions and negotiate contract renewals.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to coordinate the implementation and ongoing support of EFT services for clients.
  • Represent SHAZAM at trade shows and associations to generate leads and strengthen partnerships.
  • Monitor client accounts to identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional EFT products and services.
  • Provide timely and effective resolution of client inquiries and issues related to EFT solutions, maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and competitive offerings to advise clients proactively.
  • Prepare and deliver regular reports on client activity, sales performance, and market feedback to senior management.

What you need:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in client management or sales within the financial services or payment solutions industry.
  • Strong understanding of electronic funds transfer systems, payment processing, and related compliance requirements.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple client accounts and deliver customized solutions in a remote work setting.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential for building trust and maintaining long-term client relationships.
  • Analytical skills help in assessing client data and market trends to identify growth opportunities and tailor solutions accordingly.
  • Proven ability to think critically and solve problems in fast paced environments, with a focus on strengthening client relationships and driving business outcomes.
  • Ability to travel 50%, including some overnight travel to various locations.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license to drive on Company business and provide documentation of current personal auto insurance ($300,000 in personal liability coverage is required).

What'll makes you stand out:

  • Experience working with EFT platforms or payment gateway technologies.
  • Demonstrated success in a remote sales or client service role.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and data analytics tools to track client engagement and sales metrics.

What's in it for you:

  • A mission-driven company with a strong sense of purpose
  • A hybrid work environment that values flexibility and collaboration
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • A culture that values innovation, integrity, and community impact
  • Excellent benefits:
    • Health, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
    • Flexible spending and health savings accounts
    • Life insurance and short- and long-term disability provided at no cost
    • Time away from work – PTO, VTO, paid parental leave, and company holidays
    • Educational assistance

Actual compensation is based on various factors, such as geographic location, experience, education, and/or skill level, and is finalized at the time of offer.

SHAZAM is an equal opportunity employer, including those with disabilities or status as a protected veteran. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; ITS, Inc./SHAZAM will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa).

Please be aware that SHAZAM may use an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool to assist in the review and screening of job applications for this position. The AI system is designed to help our team efficiently identify qualified candidates by identifying relevant skills and experience within submitted applications. All final hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

Description

VAST Data is revolutionizing the data infrastructure landscape with its innovative approach to data platforms, AI acceleration, and storage architecture. Our mission is to simplify data infrastructure while enabling organizations to extract maximum value from their data assets in the age of AI.

﻿

Role Overview

We're looking for a dynamic Developer Advocate to serve as a bridge between technical teams and the user community. In this role, you'll champion our technologies through workshops, content, and events, helping customers and prospects understand how VAST Data and our API-first platform can transform data and AI initiatives.

﻿

﻿

Key Responsibilities

﻿

Community Building

  • Represent VAST Data at industry conferences, meetups, and events as a speaker
  • Design and deliver compelling technical workshops
  • Build relationships with developer communities, AI practitioners, and data engineers
  • Be a part of and nurture our active Cosmos community of customers and partners

Content Creation

  • Develop high-quality technical content including tutorials, blog posts, videos, and documentation
  • Create comprehensive workshop materials for both in-person and virtual delivery
  • Build applications, reference architectures, and proof-of-concepts
  • Design and implement hands-on labs for data pipelines and AI workflows

Technical Expertise

  • Demonstrating best practices for data platform implementations
  • Build and showcase integration with popular frameworks
  • Serve as a technical advisor to SEs and customers
  • Collaborate with product teams to translate customer feedback into product improvements and product adoption

AI Agent and Workflow Development & Showcasing

  • Develop proof-of-concept AI agents and data pipelines using VAST Data
  • Create educational content explaining how VAST Data enhances AI development workflows
  • Collaborate with partners to showcase pipelines used by their AI agents
  • Stay current on emerging AI technologies and frameworks to identify integration opportunities

Requirements

  • Background in software development, developer relations, advocacy, or technical evangelism
  • Public speaking with proven experience presenting technical content
  • Strong technical writing skills with a portfolio of blog posts, documentation, technical content
  • Experience creating and delivering technical workshops or training programs
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives
  • Experience with modern AI frameworks and data processing technologies
  • Familiarity with distributed computing concepts and technologies
  • Software development experience in languages and tools used in data engineering (Python, SQL, vector databases, etc.)

N﻿ice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Understanding of modern advanced storage and compute architectures, particularly open-source, and their impact on data pipeline performance
  • Knowledge of containerization, orchestration, and cloud-native technologies
  • Understanding of modern database technologies
  • Experience with VAST Data products or similar data platform technologies
  • Experience building and deploying data pipelines in production environments
  • Active social media presence in relevant technical communities
  • Previous experience working with enterprise customers in the data infrastructure space

﻿Personal Attributes

  • Comfortable speaking in front of audiences with an engaging presentation style
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while collaborating across teams
  • Creative problem-solver who can develop innovative demos and content
  • Passionate about technology education and knowledge sharing
  • Empathetic communicator who can understand and address customer pain points
  • Adaptable to changing priorities and emerging technologies

Travel Requirements

  • This position requires approximately 20% travel for conferences, customer visits, and workshops

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge data infrastructure technologies
  • Collaborative environment focused on innovation and technical excellence
  • Competitive compensation package including equity
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Flexible work arrangements as a “remote-first” company

raw.description:
Admin Executive Assistant – Operations, Compliance & ITAD | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Admin Executive Assistant to support executive administration, operational coordination, compliance workflows, client onboarding, and documentation within an IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) environment.

This is more than a traditional administrative role. You’ll serve as an important operational control layer, ensuring information is accurate, documentation is complete, follow-ups happen on time, and critical details don’t get missed.

Because the business operates in a compliance-sensitive environment, precision, organization, confidentiality, and attention to detail are essential.

If you’re someone who catches inconsistencies others miss, enjoys creating order, and takes ownership of tasks through completion, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Executive & Administrative Support

  • Manage calendars, meetings, scheduling, and day-to-day administrative coordination
  • Support leadership with priorities, communication, and follow-ups
  • Coordinate across clients, leadership, and internal teams
  • Anticipate scheduling conflicts and operational needs before they become problems
  • Track outstanding action items and ensure timely completion
  • Help protect leadership bandwidth by keeping workflows organized
  • Maintain professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information

Compliance & Documentation Support

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready documentation
  • Support compliance-sensitive processes within ITAD operations
  • Review documentation for missing, inconsistent, or incorrect information
  • Ensure records are properly organized, stored, and accessible
  • Maintain consistent documentation standards across operational systems
  • Track required documentation and follow up on missing items
  • Help ensure compliance-related records remain current and reliable

Client Onboarding & Operational Tracking

  • Track client onboarding from initiation through completion
  • Ensure required information and documentation are collected
  • Monitor outstanding tasks, follow-ups, and internal dependencies
  • Maintain clear visibility into onboarding status
  • Coordinate with clients and internal stakeholders throughout the process
  • Escalate missing information, blockers, or potential delays proactively
  • Ensure onboarding steps are completed accurately and on time

Quality Control & Accuracy

  • Review names, dates, numbers, schedules, records, and documentation before execution
  • Identify inconsistencies across systems and workflows
  • Catch potential errors before they create operational or financial issues
  • Track process and documentation changes accurately
  • Double-check critical information before submission or execution
  • Maintain strong quality-control standards across daily operations

Systems & Records Management

  • Maintain organized and accurate records across tools such as:
    • Google Workspace
    • Slack
    • Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Keep systems clean, searchable, and up to date
  • Maintain consistent naming and documentation practices
  • Ensure important information can be retrieved quickly when needed
  • Update CRM and internal systems as operational information changes
  • Maintain reliable records across administrative and compliance workflows

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations Support roles
  • Strong experience with Google Workspace
  • Experience using Slack
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities without sacrificing accuracy
  • Strong follow-through and organizational discipline
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems proactively
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality
  • Comfortable working in a process-driven environment
  • Ability to work during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience in IT Asset Disposition (ITAD)
  • Experience in compliance-heavy or highly regulated environments
  • Familiarity with audit preparation and compliance documentation
  • Experience supporting founders, executives, or leadership teams
  • Client onboarding experience
  • Operational tracking and workflow management experience
  • Experience maintaining structured records across multiple systems

Tools & Technology

Google Workspace | Gmail | Google Drive | Google Docs | Google Sheets | Google Calendar | Slack | Salesforce | CRM Systems | Documentation & Workflow Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Notice small inconsistencies quickly
  • Naturally double-check important information
  • Prefer structured and organized systems
  • Take ownership instead of waiting to be reminded
  • Follow tasks through until they are completely resolved
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Handle confidential information responsibly
  • Stay organized while managing multiple priorities
  • Proactively flag risks instead of waiting for problems to escalate
  • Understand that accuracy is just as important as speed

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing leadership calendars, outstanding action items, client onboarding progress, and documentation requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate meetings, review records for missing or incorrect information, follow up on operational tasks, update Salesforce and internal systems, and organize compliance documentation.

You’ll also coordinate communication between clients and internal teams, verify important dates and records, and proactively flag inconsistencies or risks before they create larger problems.

In short: you ensure the administrative and operational side of the business stays accurate, organized, compliant, and under control.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and completeness of documentation
  • Zero critical operational or documentation errors
  • On-time completion of assigned tasks and follow-ups
  • Smooth and timely client onboarding
  • CRM and internal records accuracy
  • Audit-readiness of compliance documentation
  • Reduction in preventable operational issues
  • Consistency of administrative workflows
  • Leadership confidence in administrative and operational execution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-trust role working closely with leadership
  • Direct impact on operational accuracy and compliance
  • Exposure to structured ITAD and compliance workflows
  • Strong ownership over administrative and operational processes
  • Opportunity to improve documentation and workflow consistency
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Operations Manager
    • Compliance Coordinator
    • Executive Operations Lead

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a highly organized Executive Assistant or Operations Support professional who catches mistakes others miss, takes ownership of follow-through, and thrives in structured, compliance-sensitive environments, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take on a high-trust role where your attention to detail directly contributes to smoother operations, stronger compliance, accurate client onboarding, and greater leadership efficiency.

raw.description:
At Sparq, we help companies solve the right problems—not just build more technology.

We’re a modern product engineering partner blending strategy, craftsmanship, and speed to help organizations modernize confidently in the age of AI. From data ecosystems to digital products and AI acceleration, we turn complexity into clarity and ideas into impact.

If you’re driven to build what’s next, lead with empathy, and deliver excellence without ego, you’ll feel right at home at Sparq.

C2C is not available

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

Why you will enjoy Mondays again:

  • Opportunity to work alongside a talented, diverse team in a collaborative and creative environment
  • Ongoing investment in your growth through training, mentorship, and industry certifications
  • Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge technologies across multiple industries
  • Recognition programs and employee awards within an inclusive culture that celebrates great work, including our AI Innovators Program
  • Remote or hybrid work options
  • Competitive salary
  • Robust benefits package, matching 401(k) plan, and substantial PTO
  • Tuition reimbursement

A Day in the Life:

  • Partner directly with product owners and business users to uncover, clarify, and document application requirements for digital modernization initiatives.
  • Translate business needs and technical findings into clear user stories, workflow diagrams, acceptance criteria, and backlog documentation for software engineering teams.
  • Analyze API-driven integrations, including request and response flows, to understand how backend services support application functionality.
  • Review SQL queries to identify inputs, data relationships, and expected outputs, writing basic queries when needed to support requirements analysis.
  • Independently research existing functionality across Jira, Confluence, Figma, GitHub, and the live product to build context and surface informed questions.
  • Collaborate directly with developers to resolve technical ambiguity and update tickets with actionable requirements and clearly defined acceptance criteria.
  • Actively use AI tools, including Claude through our Anthropic partnership, to streamline tasks, improve the quality of your work, and share best practices with teammates while continuously seeking new ways to integrate AI into your everyday workflows
  • Partner with QA testers to establish functional test success criteria and guide business users through User Acceptance Testing.
  • Help establish consistent working conventions for requirements, tickets, and documentation while navigating an evolving environment without fully defined processes.
  • Work collaboratively with multiple Business Analysts, adapting to different approaches while maintaining alignment across shared application areas.
  • Apply experience from regulated or high-compliance environments to support thoughtful documentation, traceability, and delivery practices.

What it takes:

  • Availability to work Central Time hours to support collaboration with client and delivery teams
  • Consultative approach and problem solving skills to successfully align digital solutions with long-term business goals of the client
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance daily work, or a strong desire to do so, including a willingness to experiment, learn, and champion AI adoption within your role
  • Claude Certified Developer or Architect highly preferred; possible opportunity to obtain as a Sparq colleague
  • Commitment to understanding and exceeding client expectations
  • Ability to perform project oversight and execution of deliverables
  • Flexibility to adapt within a high-growth organization
  • Ability to lead, mentor and motivate those around them
  • Hunger for continuous learning and professional development
  • Intellectual curiosity to provide creative solutions
  • Full understanding of the software development life cycle

Operations Associate – HubSpot CRM, Deal Pipeline & Excel Reporting | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)
Location: South Africa or Latin America

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized Operations Associate to keep a high-value deal pipeline accurate, structured, and consistently moving forward.

This is not a traditional finance, investment banking, or sales role. You won’t be responsible for complex financial modeling, sourcing deals, or hitting sales quotas. Instead, your focus will be on execution, HubSpot CRM management, reporting, deal coordination, and consistent follow-through.

You’ll own the operational details behind long, 6–12 month deal cycles, ensuring every opportunity, follow-up, next step, meeting, and task is properly tracked and completed.

If you’re experienced with HubSpot, comfortable with Excel, and naturally make sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Deal Pipeline & HubSpot Management – 50%

  • Own and maintain the deal pipeline within HubSpot CRM
  • Track:
    • Inbound interest
    • Responses
    • Follow-ups
    • Deal stages
    • Next steps
  • Manage consistent follow-up across 6–12 month deal cycles
  • Keep CRM records accurate, complete, and current
  • Maintain clean:
    • Notes
    • Tasks
    • Deal stages
    • Follow-up dates
    • Next actions
  • Flag urgent, stalled, or unattended opportunities for leadership
  • Ensure no deal or important communication is overlooked
  • Monitor overdue tasks and outstanding actions
  • Keep leadership informed of priorities and next steps
  • Maintain reliable pipeline visibility at all times

Deal Execution & Operations Support – 50%

  • Maintain and update Excel and Google Sheets deal trackers
  • Organize raw information into clear:
    • Summaries
    • Reports
    • Graphs
    • Visuals
  • Support the preparation and organization of:
    • Pitch materials
    • Client-facing documents
    • Internal deal materials
  • Coordinate meetings, calendars, and deal-related calls
  • Track action items and ensure timely completion
  • Organize deal information so it is easily accessible to leadership
  • Provide administrative and operational support throughout deal execution

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
    • Deal tracking
    • CRM updates
    • Tasks
    • Follow-ups
    • Pipeline management
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Formatting
    • Templates
    • Basic data handling
    • Reporting
  • Strong written English communication skills
  • Ability to independently manage professional follow-ups
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Comfortable managing repetitive follow-ups across long deal cycles
  • Strong execution discipline and reliability
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Must be based in South Africa or Latin America

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to:
    • Finance
    • M&A
    • Investment banking
    • Deal-based environments
  • Experience supporting founders or senior executives
  • Familiarity with pitch decks and client-facing materials
  • Experience creating simple charts and data visualizations
  • Familiarity with HubSpot workflows or CRM automation
  • Experience supporting long-cycle transactions or opportunities

Tools & Technology

HubSpot | Microsoft Excel | Google Sheets | Calendar & Scheduling Tools | Internal Deal Tracking Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are exceptionally organized and detail-oriented
  • Follow through without needing repeated reminders
  • Are comfortable managing high-volume, repetitive follow-ups
  • Notice when deals, tasks, or communications are becoming stale
  • Enjoy maintaining clean systems and structured processes
  • Communicate professionally and clearly in writing
  • Are dependable with recurring operational work
  • Proactively flag issues instead of waiting for someone else to notice them
  • Take ownership of tasks through completion
  • Understand that small operational details can have a significant impact on long-cycle deals

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You’ll start by reviewing HubSpot for new activity, overdue tasks, outstanding follow-ups, and deals requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll send professional follow-ups, update deal stages and notes, maintain Excel and Google Sheets trackers, coordinate meetings, organize deal information, and prepare reports or materials for leadership.

You’ll also regularly review the pipeline for opportunities that have stalled and proactively ensure the appropriate next step happens.

In short: you keep the deal pipeline clean, organized, and moving so leadership never has to chase updates or wonder what happens next.

Key Metrics for Success

  • CRM data accuracy and completeness
  • Percentage of follow-ups completed on time
  • Number of overdue or missed tasks
  • Deal pipeline accuracy
  • Reporting accuracy and timeliness
  • Reduction in stale or unattended opportunities
  • Accuracy of Excel and Google Sheets trackers
  • Smooth meeting and deal coordination
  • Leadership confidence in pipeline visibility and operational execution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • No sales quotas or sourcing targets
  • No complex financial modeling
  • Clear, structured responsibilities and measurable outcomes
  • High ownership of a valuable deal pipeline
  • Direct exposure to leadership and high-value transactions
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and deal operations
  • Fully remote opportunity for candidates in South Africa and Latin America
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Deal Operations
    • CRM Operations
    • Business Operations
    • Executive Operations
    • M&A / Transaction Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re highly organized, experienced with HubSpot CRM, comfortable working in Excel and Google Sheets, and relentless about following through until every task is complete, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and become the operational engine that keeps high-value deals organized, accurately tracked, and consistently moving forward.

Dabei nutzt du Value-Based Selling sowie eine Win-Win-Win-Positionierung für Kunde, Atlassian und Valiantys, um messbaren Mehrwert für alle Beteiligten zu schaffen.

Diese Rolle erfordert ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im komplexen Lösungsvertrieb und im Aufbau von Netzwerken, also kein transaktionaler oder lizenzgetriebener Vertrieb, mit dem Ziel, Accounts über ein Volumen von 2 Mio. Euro hinaus zu entwickeln. Gleichzeitig sind exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten notwendig, um interne Teams zu steuern und effektiv mit C-Level-Stakeholdern zu interagieren.

Consultative Sales & Transformation Leadership
  • Durchführung von Discovery- und Advisory-Gesprächen mit Senior Stakeholdern zur Identifikation von Herausforderungen und Transformationszielen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Consultants zur Entwicklung von Service-Angeboten, die auf die Ziele der Kunden abgestimmt sind

Sales & Revenue Generation

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines Territory-Plans durch Identifikation relevanter Zielkunden, Definition von Zielen und gezielten Einsatz von Ressourcen, z. B. Marketingkampagnen
  • Fokus auf Neukundengewinnung innerhalb strategischer Enterprise Accounts und White-Space-Potenziale, etwa 75 Prozent der Tätigkeit
  • Identifikation, Qualifizierung und Entwicklung komplexer Consulting- und Service-Opportunities in strategischen Accounts in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Consulting Leadership zur Gestaltung wirkungsvoller Transformationsprogramme

Client Relationship Management

  • Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch regelmäßigen Austausch und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Situationen in Zusammenarbeit mit C-Level, Senior Management und internen Teams
  • Zusammenarbeit mit strategischen Partnern zur Förderung von Co-Selling-Initiativen und zur Erschließung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
  • Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit durch proaktive Betreuung und schnelle Unterstützung
  • Unterstützung und gelegentliche Leitung von Präsentationen und Produktdemonstrationen

Forecasting and Reporting

  • Erstellung präziser Forecasts und Reports sowie Sicherstellung der gleichen Qualität und Aktualität im Team
  • Beitrag zur strategischen und operativen Account-Planung mit Fokus auf nachhaltiges Wachstum
  • Kontinuierliche Analyse der Sales-Performance und Anpassung der Strategien zur Zielerreichung
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Reporting-Standards und Überblick über zentrale finanzielle Kennzahlen

Knowledge Development and Accreditation

  • Kontinuierlicher Ausbau des Produkt- und Lösungswissens, insbesondere im Atlassian-Umfeld
  • Erwerb und Aufrechterhaltung relevanter Zertifizierungen zur Unterstützung des Vertriebserfolgs

Collaboration and Team Effort

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur Sicherstellung einer reibungslosen Umsetzung und hoher Kundenzufriedenheit
  • Abstimmung mit anderen Account Managern zur Entwicklung gemeinsamer regionaler Strategien und zum Austausch von Best Practices
  • Aktive Teilnahme an Teammeetings sowie Übernahme von Führungsverantwortung in Meetings und Formaten

Was du mitbringst

Du verfügst über 5 bis 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb von IT- oder Professional Services, idealerweise im Umfeld von Consulting, Cloud-Transformation oder Enterprise-Lösungen. Du hast nachweislich komplexe, mehrjährige Consulting-Projekte verkauft und nicht primär Softwarelizenzen. Gleichzeitig bist du in der Lage, neue Enterprise-Kunden aktiv zu gewinnen und weiterzuentwickeln, wobei ein großer Teil deiner Tätigkeit auf Prospecting entfällt.

Erfahrung mit Atlassian-Tools ist von Vorteil, wichtiger ist jedoch deine Expertise in Transformation und organisatorischem Wandel.

Du bist stark zielorientiert und fühlst dich in einem leistungsgetriebenen Umfeld wohl. Du denkst strategisch, entwickelst fundierte Account- und Territory-Pläne und führst komplexe Sales-Zyklen erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Dabei baust du auf natürliche Weise vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu C-Level-Stakeholdern auf und arbeitest konsequent kundenorientiert.

Du bringst unternehmerisches Denken mit, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale, treibst Initiativen voran und verbesserst kontinuierlich deine Performance. Erste Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus, ebenso die Fähigkeit, Teams zu inspirieren, klare Ziele zu setzen und Ergebnisse zu liefern.

Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend, sowohl gegenüber Kunden als auch internen Stakeholdern, und kannst auf Executive-Level Einfluss nehmen.

Du bist sicher im Umgang mit internationalen Kunden und kommunizierst souverän auf Englisch und Deutsch.

Wenn du Lust hast, strategische Accounts zu entwickeln, ambitionierte Ziele zu erreichen und echten Impact zu schaffen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Warum Valiantys?

Unsere Teammitglieder sind unser größtes Kapital, und wir setzen alles daran, dass Valiantys nicht nur ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist, sondern auch eine Plattform für persönliches Wachstum.
Ownership. Du hast maßgeblichen Einfluss auf die Strategie und übernimmst Verantwortung für deinen Aufgabenbereich.
Training. Wir stellen Zeit und Budget zur Verfügung, damit du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst.
Flexibilität. Wir wissen, dass das Leben aus mehr besteht als Arbeit. Deshalb bieten wir Flexibilität und Unterstützung, um dir zu helfen, deine Lebensziele zu erreichen.
Gehalt & Benefits. Wir honorieren Engagement und Leistung mit einer attraktiven Vergütung sowie einem ausgezeichneten Leistungspaket.
eGym Wellpass. Mit einer eGym Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft erhältst du Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitnessstudios in ganz Deutschland.
Wenn du bereit bist, das Ruder zu übernehmen und die digitale Innovation gemeinsam mit Valiantys voranzutreiben, dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams!
Valiantys ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber:innen werden unabhängig von ihrem persönlichen Hintergrund, ihrer Identität oder ihren Überzeugungen berücksichtigt.
Wir können im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses teilweise künstliche Intelligenz (KI) einsetzen, zum Beispiel zur Prüfung von Bewerbungen, zur Analyse von Lebensläufen oder zur Auswertung von Antworten. Diese Tools unterstützen unser Recruiting-Team, ersetzen jedoch nicht die menschliche Beurteilung. Die endgültigen Einstellungsentscheidungen werden stets von Menschen getroffen. Wenn Sie weitere Informationen darüber wünschen, wie Ihre Daten verarbeitet werden, kontaktieren Sie uns bitte.

raw.title: Associate General Counsel
raw.excerpt: A Rare Opportunity to Shape the Future of GenomicsJoin a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare.
raw.description:
A Rare Opportunity to Shape the Future of Genomics

Join a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare. At BillionToOne, we've built a category-defining, publicly traded company on Nasdaq where transparency fuels trust, collaboration drives breakthroughs, and every contribution moves the needle on our mission to make life-changing diagnostics accessible to all. We don't just aim for incremental improvements; we build products that are 10x better than anything that exists today.

Our scientists, engineers, sales executives, and visionaries are united by an unwavering commitment to changing the standard of care in prenatal and cancer diagnostics. This is where cutting-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

BillionToOne is looking to hire an Assistant General Counsel, its fifth attorney, for its growing Legal & Compliance team to advise on a variety of issues. This role will have a significant impact on developing and implementing legal and compliance policies, practices, and systems. You will partner and collaborate with members of our Finance, Sales, Market Access, Reimbursement, R&D, Marketing, Supply Chain, and HR teams. This role reports to our General Counsel, Chief Compliance Officer & Secretary and can be located onsite, hybrid, or fully remote (with occasional travel).

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively identify and address legal and compliance risks across Product, Marketing, Commercial Operations, Market Access/Reimbursement, Research & Development, People Ops and Finance — anticipating issues rather than waiting to be asked
  • Independently identify gaps in existing policies and processes and drive build-out of compliance infrastructure
  • Develop processes and infrastructure to ensure compliance with applicable external requirements, soliciting feedback from internal stakeholders, preparing and drafting policies/SOPs and overseeing implementation and training in a variety of areas
  • Advise on company contracts, including drafting, negotiating, reviewing, interpreting, and managing strategic, high-value contracts
  • Take ownership of legal questions in unfamiliar subject areas — research, collect business input, and drive to resolution with appropriate escalation
  • Partner with legal team members to develop and build legal and compliance infrastructure and program for lab services/life science organization

Requirements:

  • Genuine interest and ability to learning new areas of law and business, with a proven track record of taking on projects in unfamiliar areas and driving them to completion
  • Ability to be highly resourceful, adaptable, creative and nimble in a high-growth, fast-paced environment
  • Track record of taking on unfamiliar legal problems with minimal oversight and driving them to a positive result for the business
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity in a lean legal team, making judgment calls without a playbook
  • JD and licensed to practice law in one or more US jurisdictions
  • 5+ years of experience in a law firm and/or in-house legal department, ideally with exposure to life science or health care organizations
  • Experience advising commercial leaders and colleagues on business strategies, product promotion, sales programs and transactions and other commercial initiatives.
  • Experience developing processes to comply with legal/regulatory requirements, drafting and implementing policies and procedures, and delivering employee training
  • Exposure to some combination of the following subject areas: commercial compliance, securities/corporate governance, contract drafting and negotiation, intellectual property, and labor and employment matters
  • Strong team-player with willingness to roll-up sleeves and pitch in wherever needed
  • Strong leadership skills, with ability to clearly communicate effective legal solutions to leadership and colleagues in a collaborative yet consultative way that meet business objectives yet appropriately mitigate risks

Nice-to-Haves:

Familiarity with some or all of the following:

  • Start-up, emerging high-growth company experience
  • Molecular diagnostics/genetic company or CLIA lab

Benefits And Perks:

  • Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients
  • Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings
  • The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousand patients
  • Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%
  • Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)
  • Supplemental fertility benefits coverage
  • Retirement savings program including a 4% Company match
  • Increase paid time off with increased tenure
  • Latest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)
  • Free daily on-site lunches provided from top eateries
  • A variety of perks on campus (state of the art gym, restaurant)
  • Free on-site EV charging (compatible with all EVs, including Tesla)

At BillionToOne, we are proud to offer a combination of a (1) base pay range (actual amount offered is based on experience and salary/equity options split that the candidate chooses), (2) generous equity options offering, (3) corporate bonus program, on top of (4) industry leading company benefits (free healthcare options, 401k match, very generous fully paid parental leave, etc.).

For this position, we offer a total compensation package up to $383,156 per year, including a base pay range of $241,165 - $267,962 per year.

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

BillionToOne is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
Unity Confirm™enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.
Our Northstar® liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers for 2025 and we're Great Place to Work certified, with 100% of our people willing to go the extra mile, even as we've scaled to over 700 employees.

Our Future

Headquartered in Menlo Park with facilities in Union City, CA, and a new lab opening in Austin, TX in 2027, we're continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible in molecular diagnostics. We're just getting started.

Ready to help us change the world, one molecule at a time? Learn more at billiontoone.com
