raw.title: Associate Director Ethics & Compliance
raw.excerpt: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back.
raw.description:
Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.


We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

Purpose of the Function

The Associate Director Ethics & Compliance is a key member of our globally operating Ethics & Compliance team who will mainly support our commercial and medical operations in the European Region incl. Australia and Canada. This is an opportunity to further develop a best-in-class compliance program by role modelling the business partnership with all functions within argenx. In this role you will be a key advisor across the product life cycle and an enabler of successful product launches and commercialisation at a regional and country level. The responsibilities will include advising on key projects and day to day activities, developing policies or other written standards and training materials incl. providing trainings in the countries, supporting with auditing and performing monitoring activities and other general compliance activities and specifically fostering the strong ethical culture of argenx.

Roles & Responsibilities

In close collaboration with the Ethics & Compliance colleagues, this role is responsible for high quality and timely guidance in all areas of the business, customer facing activities, and country specific compliance issues. The role will actively lead and contribute to compliance projects, issues, and priorities across the Global Legal and Compliance function.

Your primary areas of focus are:

  • Advise the business functions regarding compliance and continue to evolve the Global Ethics & Compliance program in the region and ensure that it is consistent with the values and principles of the organisation, fit for purpose and complies with applicable legal and regulatory requirements
  • Serving as an advisor to regional and local commercial and medical teams to provide compliance-based input and direction across product portfolio
  • Review and advise on interactions with patients/Patient Organisations, healthcare professionals, institutions, payors, regulatory agencies and other external stakeholders
  • Draft and implement appropriate policies, procedures and guidance, in collaboration with the Head of Ethics & Compliance DM & Germany, Legal and other Ethics & Compliance colleagues, to ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations and codes applicable in the respective countries and region (excluding cGMP, cGCP and other GxP guidelines)
  • Support adherence to transparency reporting requirements and reporting obligations where required
  • Conduct or assist in compliance-related investigations and other allegations of misconduct, as required
  • Prepare and deliver Ethics & Compliance training and education to the organisation incl. field-based employees to ensure understanding of employee responsibilities and overall Ethics & Compliance framework, as well as related policies and procedures
  • Foster the strong ethical culture of argenx
  • Other duties as assigned

Skills & Competencies

  • Regional experience with launching new products and/or new indications, healthcare compliance systems, training employees, engagement of healthcare professionals and transparency are all essential
  • Team-player, able to work well with others and communicate with cross-functional colleagues and senior leadership
  • Strong interpersonal and oral and written communication skills; a collaborator who communicates in an open, clear, complete, timely and consistent manner in a multi-cultural and multi-lingual global environment.
  • Shows flexibility and is open to change in a growing, multi-cultural environment; strong motivation and ability to champion a comprehensive compliance program that is integrated well with the company’s business and culture
  • Able to innovate, analyse and solve problems with minimal supervisory input, anticipating and identifying Ethics & Compliance and other business risks; capable of strategic thinking and proposing innovative solutions to compliance-related challenges
  • Solid understanding of business goals and legal, compliance and regulatory landscape in Europe
  • High degree of personal, professional and corporate ethics, integrity and responsibility
  • Ambitious, inquisitive naturally, a quick study, with demonstrated eagerness to continuously learn, self-improve and develop. This includes being comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a diverse environment
  • Passionate and prepared to lead and contribute to our culture, which is driven by our corporate values of co-creation, innovation, empowerment, excellence, and humility

Education & Experience

  • 4-7 years of regional biopharmaceutical industry experience in a relevant compliance function, with extensive experience within a commercial stage pharmaceutical or biotech company
  • Legal degree preferred, other relevant accreditations or degrees considered
  • Fluent in English; other language skills (Italian, Spanish, French or German) preferred
  • Regional Experience with launching new products and/or new indications, healthcare compliance systems, training employees, engagement of healthcare professionals and transparency are all essential
  • Expertise in the areas of European corporate commercial healthcare law and regulation related to the development and commercialisation of pharmaceutical products
  • Regional Experience in specialty markets, particularly rare diseases, preferred
  • Expertise in the relevant industry codes and guidelines
  • Travel 25-30%

‎

Note: The recruiter will share the locally applicable annual base salary hiring range, provided in your country’s currency, during the recruitment process. This information will reflect market conditions, role scope, and internal guidelines specific to your location.

This job is eligible to participate in our short-term and long-term incentives program.

The hiring range displayed above is the range of possible base pay compensation that argenx believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting. The hiring range is based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range depends on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, prior education and experience, job-related knowledge and demonstrated skills. argenx may pay more or less than the posted range and this range may be modified in the future.


At argenx, all applicants are welcomed in an inclusive environment. They will receive equal consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics. argenx is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.


Before you submit your application, CV or any other personal details to us, please review our argenx Privacy Notice for Job Applicants to learn more about how argenx B.V. and its affiliates (“argenx”) will handle and protect your personal data. If you have any questions or you wish to exercise your privacy rights, please contact our Global Privacy Office by email at .

raw.title: In-Account Business Development Director  (Account Director)
raw.excerpt: About Phase2 Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force.
raw.description:
About Phase2

Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force. In pursuit of digital experience that advances the human experience, you will do your best work, live fully, and succeed as a team.

Phase2 a digital agency passionate about customer experience, grounded in data & insights, and rooted in more than two decades of successful technology delivery. We guide industry-leading companies to what’s next in their digital landscape.

And it all begins with finding the right people who align with our values and passion for impact.

About the Role

We’re hiring an Account Director to drive consultative growth across a portfolio of clients, leading enterprise-scale digital and AI-enabled transformation initiatives.

At Phase2, we create custom digital products to solve complex business problems, partnering with clients to build tailored solutions rather than selling SaaS or subscription-based software.

This is a quota-carrying, in-account growth role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, leads with insight, and diagnoses business problems before prescribing solutions.

You’ll challenge assumptions, navigate objections, and build business cases that unlock meaningful investment.

This role demands a consultative selling and strategic mindset. Success requires the ability to sell vision, outcomes, and transformation, often before clients fully understand what they need.

You will operate at the intersection of digital experience, technology modernization, and transformative AI, helping clients move from fragmented initiatives to integrated, high-impact solutions.

  • This position reports to the SVP, Account Management
  • Base salary: $110,000–$150,000
  • On-Target Earnings (OTE): $135,000–$200,000
  • Commission: $25,000–$50,000 annually at 100% of quota; uncapped commission potential

Who You Are

  • A consultative seller and portfolio growth strategist.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment where solutions must be shaped in real time.
  • Ask sharp questions, uncover root problems, and reframe client thinking.
  • Are comfortable pushing back, handling objections, and navigating complexity.
  • Can translate digital and AI capabilities into the business outcomes that executives care about.
  • Know how to sell services, platforms, and transformation.
  • A hands-on closer who can own the vision, shape the strategy, and execute the deal.

What You'll Do

Drive In-Account Pipeline and Revenue Growth

  • Generate a robust pipeline that leads to closing $5M+ in new revenue within 12 months across an existing portfolio and newly signed clients.
  • Proactively identify areas of opportunity within accounts, lead the complete sales cycle from discovery and rigorous qualification through to pitch, strategic pricing, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Maintain clean, accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce.
  • Shape deal strategy, pricing, and scope for high-value digital and AI engagements.
  • Navigate objections, procurement hurdles, and ambiguity with confidence.

Sell Digital & AI Solutions

  • Translate AI and digital capabilities into measurable business impact using value-selling methodologies.
  • A thought leader who guides clients through practical and transformative AI integration across marketing, content, IT, and digital operations.
  • Position AI, digital experience, and modernization as business imperatives.
  • Build compelling value narratives tied to ROI, risk reduction, speed, and competitive advantage.
  • Translate complex technology concepts into clear executive-level business cases.

Act as a Trusted Client Advisor

  • Build deep relationships with Senior and C-Suite stakeholders within accounts.
  • Serve as a point of escalation, balancing client needs with internal delivery realities.
  • Partner closely with delivery, strategy, and leadership teams to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Represent Phase2 at industry events and maintain an active, credible thought leadership presence.
  • Travel to client sites, internal offices, or industry events as needed (typically up to 20%).

Other Ways You’ll Make an Impact

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape and deliver solutions that drive measurable value.
  • Champion client successes internally by ensuring visibility across teams and leadership.
  • Support marketing in developing case studies and thought leadership, highlighting client impact.
  • Maintain strong leadership presence within accounts by positioning forward-looking, strategic work that aligns with where the market is headed.
  • Collaborate with platform and technology partners to identify and pursue co-selling opportunities.
  • Contribute to a culture of performance, knowledge-sharing, and sales excellence.

What You'll Need

  • 10+ years of consultative digital sales experience within an agency, consultancy, or transformation-led firm, with a strong track record of growing existing client relationships
  • Success in overseeing client portfolios contributing $5 million+ in revenue annually.
  • Ability to generate $5M+ in sales, including expansions and renewals, within the assigned portfolio within 12 months.
  • Strong understanding of digital experience, platforms, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and shaping solutions collaboratively with clients.
  • Experience influencing senior executives through strategic insight, persuasive communication, and effective negotiation.

What Will Immediately Set You Apart

  • Experience navigating legacy systems, organizational resistance, and competing priorities.
  • Ability to clearly generate buyer demand and articulate why clients need to act now.
  • Demonstrated use of AI in your own workflow and client conversations.

What Would Be Nice to Have

  • Experience in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, pharma, wellness, financial services).
  • Familiarity with platforms like Drupal, Acquia, Adobe Experience Cloud, Optimizely, or similar DXPs.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership (e.g., panels, blog posts, speaking engagements) in AI or digital transformation.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently hit or exceed $5M+ in annual sales
  • Your pipeline is active, qualified, and forecastable
  • Clients see you as a strategic partner, not a vendor
  • You’re shaping client roadmaps and influencing long-term investment decisions
  • You’re trusted internally to handle the most complex, high-stakes opportunities

What You'll Get

Fully Remote

Work from anywhere with the support of a remote-first team and flexible culture.

Competitive Compensation

Your salary is determined based on experience, education, certifications, skills, and current market conditions.

Comprehensive Benefits

Full coverage including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability. We also offer supplemental insurance options through Aflac and Transamerica.

Wellness That Rewards You

Our fun and interactive wellness program offers rewards for participation.

Retirement Savings

A 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution–no match required and 100% vested after just 90 days.

Generous Time Off

You’ll start with 16 paid vacation days, 4 personal days, and 1 volunteer day each year. Vacation and personal time increase with your tenure, recognizing your continued contributions.

Paid Parental Leave

We offer up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents and up to 6 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, based on your tenure. This includes support for adoption and foster placement, along with the option to extend time off through additional unpaid leave.

Family-Building Support

Inclusive fertility, adoption, and surrogacy benefits through Kindbody, along with virtual health coaching and care navigation.

New Hire Office Stipend

Receive a $500 stipend to personalize and equip your home workspace for success.

What the Environment Looks Like

Physical Demands

  • Frequently remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time.
  • Occasional adjusting or moving of light objects up to 20 pounds in all directions.
  • Continuous communication on live video chats, calls, and through emails and messaging platforms for the purpose of exchanging information.
  • Continuous repetitive movements that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Travel, sometimes frequent, is expected.

Mental Demands

  • Comprehension - Must continuously be able to understand directions and adhere to established procedures. Must also be able to gather information from clients and employees and synthesize this information in a meaningful way. May also be responsible for making improvements or recommendations to existing procedures.
  • Organization - Must continuously be able to gather and classify information, store information learned from conversations and communications, and then be able to quickly recall, interpret, and explain information.
  • Reasoning and Decision Making - Must continuously use logic to analyze and interpret information, and prioritize.
  • Communication - Must continuously express or exchange ideas and meaning with employees and clients.
  • Resilience - Must continuously adapt well in the face of workplace stressors.

raw.excerpt: This role is open for LATAM based candidates About us:Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy.
raw.description:
This role is open for LATAM based candidates

About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.
The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.
Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.
As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role

We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and maintain our cloud infrastructure and platform systems. You'll work closely with development teams to create scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure that powers our products.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Designs, implements, and manages AWS cloud infrastructure, including VPCs, EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, Lambda, and other foundational services.

Job Title: Project Director, eCOA Customer Delivery - Evinova (Remote)

Job Location: Wilmington, Delaware, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

WHY JOIN US?Evinova is a health-tech business focused on accelerating better health outcomes by advancing digital transformation across the life sciences sector. By combining science-based expertise, evidence-led rigor, and deep human insight, we design digital solutions that enable healthcare to work better for everyone. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, data, and analytics, we are helping unlock the full potential of digital health, transforming how clinical research is conducted, how care is delivered, and how patients experience healthcare. Our solutions are built to scale, driving efficiency, improving decision-making, and ultimately delivering better outcomes for patients worldwide.

At Evinova, we are driven by a shared purpose to transform health through data and digital innovation. Our teams collaborate across disciplines to solve complex challenges, continuously learning and evolving in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

We also recognize the importance of flexibility and balance. Our ways of working support both individual needs and team collaboration. To foster connection and collaboration, employees are expected to work from the office three days per week, creating opportunities for in-person teamwork, innovation, and meaningful connection.

This is a remote position that can be based anywhere in the United States.

About the Role

As a Project Director at Evinova, you will oversee projects of all complexity levels, ensuring successful delivery through strategic planning, stakeholder collaboration, and agile execution. This role will suit someone who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, can navigate complex clinical operations landscapes, and isn’t afraid to roll up their sleeves to ensure successful project delivery.

The ideal candidate combines deep project management expertise with a strong understanding of digital health ecosystems, emerging technologies, and user-centered design. The role requires someone who is willing to take on challenges, unblock issues and lead high-impact initiatives that drive innovation, enhance customer experience, and enable business transformation within clinical trials.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee multiple digital health implementation projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.

  • Proactively remove blockers and support cross-functional teams to maintain momentum across project lifecycles.

  • Act as the main point of contact for senior stakeholders (internal and external), building strong, trust-based relationships and ensuring alignment on goals, risks, and progress.

  • Own reporting and risk tracking for your project portfolio, providing clear, accurate, and timely updates to internal leadership and customer stakeholders.

  • Be the face of delivery; willing to pick up the phone, deliver tough messages with empathy, and win customer confidence through credibility, clarity, and consistency.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders. Navigate complexity with diplomacy, managing competing priorities and expectations.

  • Champion hands-on delivery—ready to dive into the details when needed to ensure forward movement and issue resolution.

  • Set up mechanisms to continuously capture team feedback, identify delivery pain points, and evolve how we deliver based on real-world learning.

  • Coach delivery team members on best practices, delivery hygiene, and ownership. Encourage a culture of “find the answer, share the answer”—where lessons learned become reusable knowledge for others.

  • Operate within the bounds of relevant regulatory frameworks (e.g., GxP, 21 CFR Part 11), with a strong understanding of Clinical Operations and eCOA (electronic Clinical Outcome Assessments).

  • Constructively challenge project scope to protect delivery timelines and quality. Maintain a commercial lens, ensuring customer needs are met while safeguarding business interests.

About You

You are highly organized, solution-oriented, and tech-savvy. You have experience in managing projects for enterprise customers and a foundational understanding of clinical operations. You thrive in customer-facing roles and are passionate about improving healthcare through technology. You want to expand your career in the digital health space, with the potential to move into project management or product configuration.

You coach teams on delivery best practices and foster a culture of accountability. You encourage others to solve problems independently, share what they’ve learned, and avoid reinventing the wheel. You give clear, honest feedback and focus on helping teams continuously improve how they deliver.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

  • Advanced degree, PMP certification, and/or project management solution experience preferred.

  • 10+ years of project management experience, with at least 4 years in digital or technology project leadership roles.

  • Proven understanding of clinical trial operations, with relevant experience in R&D industry, specifically in clinical trials, with a focus on technology or software configuration

  • Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact professionally with customers and internal teams.

  • Solution-oriented mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues efficiently.

  • Experience in a customer-facing role, with a strong commitment to delivering excellent service.

Status:Full Time / Exempt

Location:Remote; Must reside and be authorized to work in the United States of America;preference for candidates who reside in the Washington, DC metro

To Apply:Applicants must submit their applicationthrough our search firm,Grossman Solutions.

About PolicyLink

PolicyLink is a research and action institute working to advance a nation that truly governs for all. We advance structural solutions, shape conditions, build connections, and strengthen the field infrastructure needed to deliver on the promise of a nation where all can thrive. We are relentlessly focused on delivering results at a scale that matches the challenges — and the potential — of this country.

To achieve this vision, we concentrate our efforts in five key arenas that shape how the nation governs and delivers for its people:

  • Thelegal and regulatory systemsthat shape our democracy and economy, including amending and advancing the U.S. Constitution

  • Federal agencies, which are the engines of public policy and implementation that must deliver results

  • State and local governmentsthat deliver the benefits of citizenship to our everyday lives in the cities and states where we live

  • We the People— whose collective consciousness and action must be activated toward everyone’s thriving

  • The institutional leaders, decision makers, and capital allocatorswho hold disproportionate influence over how the nation governs

Across these arenas, we are working to awakena shared consciousnessthat embraces the humanity of every person; to shape government to deliver results for all; and to align the full force of our public, private, and civic resources to realize this future.

Position Overview

PolicyLink is seeking an experienced and strategic Vice President to join its Governing for All team.

  • The Governing for All Agenda is PolicyLink’s leadership strategy to awaken a shared consciousness embracing the humanity of every person, reshape government to deliver results for all, and align the full force of public, private, and civic resources toward this vision.

  • It is our moonshot: a bold, long-term effort that requires taking risks, focusing on systemic change, and committing to work whose full impact may not be seen for generations.

  • The Governing for All Agenda includes:

  1. Building a legal and regulatory basisto proactively advance an agenda rooted in equal protection, as guaranteed in the Constitution and grounded in legal precedent.

  2. Changing policy and practice in key places and on key issuesso that governing policies and institutions are redesigned to deliver results for everyone.

  3. Shifting narratives and building relationshipsthat engage a broad, diverse set of champions and alliances, so that a critical mass of people can imagine, believe, and work toward a nation that works for all.

Across these three dimensions, PolicyLink plays a leadership role – holding the long-term strategy; coordinating a diverse alliance of partners and advisors with different expertise, networks, and functions; marshalling resources; and measuring progress to inform and adapt our approach over time.

The Vice President will play a critical role in achieving the Governing for All Agenda and ensuring PolicyLink can fulfill its mission of redesigning our democracy and economy to serve all people.

The Vice President will serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the Chief Strategy Officer in driving and executing the strategic vision of PolicyLink. The Vice President will help the organization achieve its ambitious goals by fostering alignment and collaboration and building an environment that prioritizes results-based accountability and population-level outcomes.

Working closely with the Chief Strategy Officer, the Vice President will develop and implement organizational strategies and ensure strong communication and coordination across the legal, policy, and operations teams.

  • The Vice President will ensure that teams are supported and positioned to deliver by managing processes to increase effectiveness and collaboration, monitoring progress, and serving as a strategic thought partner and resource.

  • The Vice President will work with the Chief Strategy Officer in translating organizational vision into clear priorities, developing clear metrics and measures of progress, supporting and ensuring each team is meeting its goals, and ensuring alignment of program and operations to mission.

  • The Vice President will support the enhancement of PolicyLink’s visibility and influence through strong partner engagement and relationship building.

  • The ideal candidate is an experienced organizational leader who can “hold the whole” and support high-performing teams, understands policy and the changing political environment, is an excellent manager of people and processes, and has a proven record of developing deep authentic relationships. The ideal candidate brings an entrepreneurial spirit to their work – a leader who believes in big ideas and making the impossible possible, drives vision to action, and galvanizes colleagues and stakeholders.

The Vice President reports directly to the Chief Strategy Officer.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a thought partner to the Chief Strategy Officer, helping execute the strategic vision of PolicyLink, fostering cohesion and alignment, and ensuring rigor and organizational credibility.

  • Translate organizational vision and bold ideas into clear priorities and workplans, bridging activity to outcomes that impact people at scale.

  • Manage strategic projects and initiatives in the Governing for All portfolio, including direct supervision of staff.

  • Build internal systems and processes that drive efficiency, communication and knowledge sharing, and accountability across the legal, policy, and operations teams.

  • Define metrics, monitor progress, and ensure each team is meeting goals and accomplishing deliverables.

  • Support the Chief Strategy Officer in organizational growth and development, including pursuing strategic funding opportunities and program expansion.

  • Heighten the visibility of Governing for All, helping enhance the organization’s sphere of influence and credibility.

  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with existing partners.

  • Identify and cultivate strategic relationships with new partner organizations that support PolicyLink’s mission.

  • Support the building of a culture that strives for achievement, outcomes, and excellence.

Experience Qualifications

  • A demonstrated commitment to PolicyLink’s vision of a nation that truly governs for all.

  • A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in senior organizational leadership.

  • Experience working in advocacy, government, public policy, think tanks or research organizations preferred.

  • Proven track record aligning program and operations to organizational strategy with leadership and senior staff.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of federal and state policy development and advocacy processes.

  • Commitment to values-based leadership and a people-management style that is results-oriented, collaborative and fosters inclusivity and belonging.

  • A self-starter who brings flexibility, initiative, and an entrepreneurial spirit to their work.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills along with excellent judgment.

  • Exceptional relationship building skills, ability to develop and maintain relationships with a variety of stakeholders.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to take vision and translate that into actionable goals and deliverables.

  • Comfortable with results-based accountability and learning.

  • Experience managing complexity and rigor in the work environment.

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional and multicultural teams.

Compensation and Benefits

PolicyLink offers competitive salaries commensurate with the experience and skills of our employees. The starting salary range for this position is $225,000–$250,000.

Additionally, PolicyLink provides a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision plans.

  • 401(k) with employer and employer-matching contributions that vest immediately. New employees are eligible to participate within one month of their date of hire.

  • Flexible Spending Account.

  • Short- and long-term disability insurance.

  • Group term life insurance plus guaranteed-issue voluntary life insurance.

  • Unlimited vacation and sick leave and other generous leave benefits.

  • Three required organization reset weeks plus 13 paid holidays.

Location and Work Environment

This is a 100% remote position. However, there is a preference for candidates who reside in the Washington, DC metro area. Exceptional candidates who reside elsewhere may be considered. Candidates must be willing to travel as needed.

To Apply

We have partnered with Grossman Solutions on this search. To apply, pleasesubmit a resume and cover letter online at.

The cover letter should be compelling and include the response to the following prompt:

  • How has your previous experience aligned with PolicyLink’s vision of a nation that truly governs for all?

Please do not use AI to help draft your cover letter. We want to know how you think and write. Applications will be considered on a rolling basis.

No phone calls or emails please. Only those selected to participate in our hiring process will be contacted.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT

PolicyLink strongly values equity and believes in a just and fair society where all can participate, prosper, and reach their full potential. We work toward a more inclusive world and as such we are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, skin color, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or parenthood. PolicyLink is committed to maintaining a diverse and multicultural working environment.

Proof of eligibility to work in the United States must be provided if selected for hire.

raw.description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

Job Summary

This is a rare 0→1 opportunity to build a financial platform from the ground up within an established and profitable ecosystem.

We are looking for a highly hands-on Founding Fintech Engineer – Banking & Payments who has previously built serious financial infrastructure and now wants significantly more ownership.

You will work directly with the founders and alongside an existing technical developer to architect and build a neobank-style platform spanning business onboarding, KYC/KYB, accounts, payments, cards, FX, ledgers, reconciliation, and money movement.

This is not a traditional engineering management position. We are looking for a strong individual contributor or technical lead who remains deeply technical, enjoys writing production code, and is comfortable solving difficult problems without an established playbook.

As one of the earliest engineers on the financial product, you will have substantial influence over architecture, technology choices, financial domain models, provider integrations, engineering standards, and eventually the team built around the platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and build core financial infrastructure, including accounts, balances, ledgers, KYC/KYB workflows, transaction state machines, and reconciliation systems.
  • Design and implement integrations with regulated banking partners, card issuers, payment providers, and payment rails including ACH, wires, international payments, and FX.
  • Build provider-independent architecture that enables integration with multiple banks and financial infrastructure partners without creating dependency on a single provider.
  • Develop secure, reliable financial APIs and data models capable of supporting complex transaction and money-movement workflows.
  • Build asynchronous systems involving queues, events, retries, idempotency, exception handling, and transaction processing.
  • Develop card issuing and card management integrations alongside multi-currency and FX functionality.
  • Build internal operations, compliance, permissions, limits, and approval tooling.
  • Own systems and features end-to-end, from architecture and database design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.
  • Work directly with the founders to translate business and product requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Establish engineering standards and technical foundations that can support the future engineering team.
  • Take initiative in ambiguous situations and independently identify solutions to complex technical and product problems.

Requirements

  • 3–8+ years of professional software engineering experience with excellent backend or full-stack fundamentals.
  • Strong hands-on experience building production-grade APIs, backend services, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience working on complex systems where reliability, consistency, and data integrity are critical.
  • Strong database architecture, data modeling, and system design skills.
  • Experience with asynchronous workflows, including queues, events, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.
  • Strong engineering judgment and the ability to balance speed, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Demonstrated experience owning technical systems or major product areas end-to-end.
  • Strong product instincts and an ability to translate ambiguous requirements into working software.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, early-stage or 0→1 environment.
  • A natural technical leader who takes initiative without needing a large team or established processes.
  • Highly hands-on and genuinely excited to continue writing and shipping production code.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Significant hands-on experience within fintech, neobanking, banking infrastructure, payments, or financial technology.
  • Experience building core banking, payment, ledger, card, FX, reconciliation, or money-movement infrastructure.
  • Previous experience as an individual contributor or technical lead at a leading fintech, neobank, payments company, or financial infrastructure provider.
  • Background at companies similar to Revolut, Wise, Monzo, N26, Nubank, Brex, Stripe, Plaid, Airwallex, Nium, Razorpay, Adyen, Checkout.com, PayPal, Column, or Modern Treasury.
  • Experience designing financial ledgers, transaction state machines, or reconciliation systems.
  • Familiarity with KYC/KYB, compliance workflows, and regulated banking integrations.
  • Experience with card issuing or payment-processing infrastructure.
  • Experience building multi-currency or FX-heavy financial products.
  • Experience integrating multiple banking or financial infrastructure providers into a single platform.
  • Previous experience joining an engineering organization early and helping take a product from 0→1.

Benefits

💰 Milestone-based compensation

🌎 Fully remote and flexible work environment

🚀 High-impact founding role with 0→1 ownership

📈 Direct influence over architecture and technical direction

🎯 Opportunity to build on top of an already profitable platform

🛠️ Modern tech stack and provider-agnostic architecture

🧠 Collaborative environment working directly with experienced founders

raw.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

raw.description:
About The Team

The ALX Community Experience team is a high-performing, impact-driven team that thrives on collaboration and scale. We embrace innovation, test new ideas, and go the extra mile to deliver meaningful results and experiences for our Learners and Alumni. Grounded in data and fueled by solutions, we hold ourselves and each other accountable to exceptionally high standards, enabling us to consistently grow and strengthen the ALX Community across markets.

Do you excel in fast-paced environments where ambitious goals drive your work? Do you bring an analytical mindset that helps you identify trends, improve systems, and translate insights into action? Can you turn a newsletter or an eHub post into something members actually stop to read? Are you a natural relationship-builder who can foster trust and collaboration across regions and teams? Are you ready to roll up your sleeves, adapt quickly, and do whatever it takes to ensure the success of our Community?

If so, then this could be the role for you.

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

  • Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.
  • Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.
  • Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey.

Our impact thus far:

  • 205k+ learners since 2021
  • 117k youth in work
  • 13k youth starting own ventures
  • 66k youth in jobs through entrepreneurship

Visit our website to learn more about our digital revolution.

Role Summary

As the Community Program Specialist, you'll embed community across the ALX talent journey, from selection and recruitment through learning, transition, and alumni engagement. You'll own ALX's virtual community presence, including eHub, along with the community's newsletters and communications, working cross-functionally with Community Managers, Marketing, Learning, and other teams to deliver one consistent, member-driven experience, in person and online.

Specific Responsibilities

Program Management

  • Design and implement strategies to embed community at every stage of the ALX talent journey (selection, recruitment, learning, transition, alumni).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Recruitment, Learning, Alumni) to ensure community-driven approaches are integrated into their workflows.
  • Develop frameworks and toolkits/playbooks to support Regions in driving community initiatives.

Community Integration

  • Ensure the community is member-led and city-driven, with central support for strategy, frameworks, and resource allocation.
  • Implement one ALX community: bring learners and alumni into a single, unified community rather than treating them as separate audiences, so the transition from learner to alumnus feels continuous, not like leaving one group to join another.

Online Community & Digital Engagement (eHub)

  • Own and manage eHub, the ALX virtual community platform, as the digital home for learners and alumni, keeping it active, well-moderated, and useful.
  • Set up and maintain the eHub structure (groups, channels, resources) so it matches the talent journey and supports member needs at every stage.
  • Drive day-to-day engagement on eHub: start discussions, welcome new members, surface relevant content, and moderate conversations in line with community guidelines.
  • Track and report on eHub engagement metrics (active users, posts, response times, sentiment) and use the data to improve the platform over time.
  • Work with stakeholders so that eHub complements other member touchpoints instead of duplicating them.
  • Manage eHub interest groups and support interest group leaders to manage the spaces as well as programming.

Newsletters & Communications

  • Plan, write, and send monthly community newsletters that inform and engage members.
  • Own the community communications calendar, keeping messaging timely, consistent, and on-brand across email, eHub, and other member channels.
  • Write and distribute announcements for community events, champion initiatives, campaigns , and key organizational updates.
  • Track newsletter and communication performance (open rates, click-through, engagement) and adjust content and cadence to improve reach and impact.
  • Keep a consistent community voice and brand across all written and digital touchpoints.

Metrics & Reporting

  • Help define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of community integration across the talent journey, including eHub and communications performance.
  • Regularly report on community engagement, member satisfaction, and program impact to stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with city leads, members, and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and collaboration.
  • Act as the central point of contact for community-related initiatives and make sure information flows smoothly across the organization.

Enablement & Amplification

  • Curate and share member-generated content and success stories, through eHub, newsletters, and other channels, to engage the broader community.
  • Enable cities to drive local engagement, share learnings, and build communities of practice.

Skill Requirements-Must Have

  • 3-4 years of experience in community management, social/digital media, internal comms, or program management, ideally in education, tech, or a membership-based organization.
  • Hands-on experience running an online community platform (e.g. Discourse, Circle, Slack, Discord, or similar) at scale.
  • Proven ability to plan and write newsletters and other member communications that people actually read, with a consistent, on-brand voice.
  • Comfortable working with email/newsletter tools (e.g. Mailchimp, HubSpot, or similar) and basic engagement analytics.
  • Experience planning and running community events, whether virtual, in-person, or hybrid.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to adapt tone and message across channels and audiences.
  • Comfortable working with data: tracking engagement metrics, spotting trends, and turning insights into action.
  • Ability to work with city leads, members, and cross-functional teams across multiple locations, including virtually.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment with a hands-on approach.

Skill Requirements – Nice To Have

  • Experience moderating or building online communities from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with community-led growth, ambassador, or referral programs.
  • Experience with graphic or content tools (e.g. Canva) to support newsletters and social content.
  • Knowledge of behavioural psychology or engagement strategies to improve retention and participation.

Due to the considerable amount of virtual working and interaction with colleagues and customers in different physical locations internationally, it is essential that the successful applicant has the drive and ethic to succeed working in small teams physically but in larger efforts virtually. Self-drive to communicate constantly using web collaboration and video conferencing is essential. As an employee, you will be encouraged to continually develop your capability & attain certifications to reflect your growth as an individual.

Employment Type

This role is a Full-time position

As this is a fully remote role, the successful applicant should be highly self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a digital-first environment. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams using tools such as Zoom, Slack, and Gmail. Strong communication is essential, and success in this role will depend on your ability to stay connected, work proactively, and take initiative.

Digital Marketing Manager

Full-Time | Exempt | Remote - Eastern or Central Time Zone Candidates Only

Help Transform Education Through Data-Driven Marketing

At Instructional Empowerment, our mission is bold: to end generational poverty and eliminate achievement gaps through redesigned rigorous Tier 1 instruction that ensures deeper learning for ALL students.

Every day, we partner with school districts across the country to improve teaching and learning by equipping educators with proven instructional frameworks that drive meaningful student outcomes.

We're seeking a strategic, data-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead our digital marketing efforts and build a high-performing marketing engine that increases awareness, engagement, and qualified pipeline among K–12 education leaders. "This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide ownership of digital marketing strategy and execution."

This role owns the strategy, execution, and optimization of our digital marketing ecosystem—including paid media, marketing automation, website optimization, analytics, and marketing technology. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and Executive Leadership to generate measurable business growth while helping educators access solutions that transform teaching and learning.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys using technology and analytics to solve complex marketing challenges.

What You'll Do

Digital Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute integrated digital marketing strategies that drive qualified leads and measurable pipeline growth.
  • Plan and manage multi-channel marketing campaigns across paid media, email, webinars, events, website content, and landing pages.
  • Build campaigns that engage prospective customers throughout every stage of the buyer journey.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities into compelling, customer-focused messaging and campaign positioning.
  • Align marketing initiatives with organizational growth objectives and business development priorities.

Paid Media & Digital Marketing

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
  • Develop audience targeting strategies focused on superintendents, district leaders, principals, instructional leaders, and classroom educators.
  • Manage campaign budgets while maximizing return on advertising spend (ROAS).
  • Continuously test and optimize ad creative, messaging, landing pages, and audience segmentation to improve campaign performance and conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & HubSpot Administration

  • Serve as the organization's primary HubSpot administrator.
  • Manage CRM data integrity, segmentation, lead scoring, workflows, forms, landing pages, dashboards, and marketing automation.
  • Develop and optimize lead nurturing programs that move prospects through the marketing and sales funnel.
  • Support efficient lead lifecycle management and marketing-to-sales handoff processes.

Marketing Technology, Analytics & Reporting

  • Own the implementation and optimization of marketing tracking infrastructure using Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
  • Ensure accurate measurement of website activity, campaign performance, attribution, and conversion events.
  • Maintain marketing integrations between HubSpot and Salesforce to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Build dashboards and executive reports that provide visibility into campaign performance, marketing-sourced pipeline, and return on investment.
  • Analyze marketing data and provide actionable recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and business results.

Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Manage website conversion strategies, including landing page development, testing, and optimization.
  • Conduct A/B testing to improve conversion rates and lead generation performance.
  • Support SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and website user experience initiatives that increase organic visibility and engagement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and Executive Leadership to ensure alignment across marketing initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Sales Leadership to improve lead quality, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and marketing contribution.
  • Support product launches, go-to-market initiatives, and strategic marketing campaigns.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • 6–8 years of progressive experience in digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing within a B2B organization.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated demand generation programs that generate qualified leads and measurable pipeline growth.
  • Extensive hands-on experience administering HubSpot Marketing Hub, including workflows, lead scoring, segmentation, reporting, and marketing automation.
  • Proven experience managing paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and other digital advertising platforms.
  • Strong experience implementing and managing Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), conversion tracking, and marketing attribution.
  • Experience working with Salesforce CRM and managing marketing technology integrations.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data, identify opportunities, and translate insights into business recommendations.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing products or services to K–12 school districts, education leaders, or other public-sector audiences.
  • Expertise in conversion rate optimization (CRO), SEO, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).
  • Experience supporting product launches and go-to-market initiatives.
  • HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Ads, or Google Analytics certifications.
  • Experience promoting webinars, conferences, and virtual events.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you'll help us achieve measurable business impact by:

  • Increasing qualified lead generation and marketing-sourced pipeline.
  • Improving campaign conversion rates while reducing cost per lead.
  • Building scalable marketing automation and lead nurturing programs.
  • Delivering accurate attribution and executive reporting that informs business decisions.
  • Strengthening alignment between Marketing and Sales to improve lead quality and pipeline velocity.
  • Growing awareness and engagement among K–12 district and school leaders.

Why Join Instructional Empowerment?

At Instructional Empowerment, your work matters. Every marketing campaign you launch and every lead you generate helps connect educators with solutions that improve teaching and learning for students across the country.
A Benefits Package Designed Around Your Well-Being

  • Multiple medical plan options, including a 100% employer-paid health plan
  • HSA and FSA options available to save for medical expenses, with employer-funded HSA contributions for those participating in eligible healthcare plans
  • Company-paid dental, vision, life, STD, and LTD coverage
  • 15 days of PTO available in your first year of employment
  • 8 paid holidays, plus 2 floating holidays
  • 401(k) with a 4% company match
  • Salary range $90,000-$95,000

If you're looking for a role where you can combine your expertise in digital marketing, automation, analytics, and technology with a mission that truly makes a difference, we encourage you to apply.

We are backed by leading global investors, including Oraseya Capital, Endeavor Catalyst, Khwarizmi Ventures, Flyer One Ventures, Access Bridge Ventures, A15, Swiss Founders Fund, and Plug & Play.

The role

As RemotePass scales, we are adding a Compliance Operations Lead to strengthen the bridge between our Head of Compliance, Operations, and the analyst team. This person will handle ambiguous cases, keep day-to-day execution moving, and ensure compliance decisions are consistent, well-documented, and defensible.

This role is flexible by design. If you want to manage the analyst team directly, we're open to that. If you'd rather come in as a senior individual contributor who's simply the team's first point of escalation, that works too — we'll shape the role around the right person. What matters more than the org chart is the operational judgment: the ability to look at an incomplete document set, a vague business description, or an unusual payment pattern, and know exactly what to do with it.

What you'll do

  • Be the first escalation point for complex KYB, KYC, and enhanced due diligence cases, before anything reaches the Head of Compliance
  • Review and QA analyst decisions — risk ratings, evidence, disposition notes — to make sure they're complete and defensible
  • Set and track team SLAs and KPIs: case aging, turnaround times, QA findings, rework rates
  • Build and maintain SOPs, escalation templates, and case documentation standards as the team scales
  • Manage sanctions, PEP, and adverse media escalations, including false-positive review and evidence retention
  • Support transaction monitoring — spotting unusual payout patterns, rapid onboarding, or high-risk activity
  • Maintain our compliance evidence register and issue/remediation tracker for audits and partner reviews
  • Coordinate with Customer Success and Operations so client-facing compliance requests stay clear and commercially practical
  • Report on compliance operations to our Head of Compliance and COO

Requirements

  • 5+ years in compliance operations, AML/financial crime, sanctions, or payments compliance — ideally with experience at a licensed money transmitter, payment institution, bank, PSP, fintech, card/spend platform, marketplace, or other regulated financial services environment.
  • Comfortable making calls on ambiguous cases: incomplete documents, unclear business activity, or elevated payment partner risk
  • Able to clearly separate a documentation gap from real risk from something that needs to go straight to the Head of Compliance
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or QA'ing analysts is a strong plus — not required
  • Strong written communication: case notes, escalation summaries, and partner responses that hold up under scrutiny
  • CAMS or CFCS certification is a plus
  • Arabic fluency is a strong plus, not a requirement

Benefits

  • Remote-First Culture: We don't just sell remote work; we live it. Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Hyper-Growth: Be part of a company that is consistently recognized for its rapid expansion and innovation.
  • Inclusion Matters: We are committed to building a diverse team. We value different perspectives and empower every individual to bring their authentic self to work.

POSITION TITLE: Director, Fiancial Reporting and Accounting Policy

Position Summary

The Director, Financial Reporting is responsible for leading the preparation and delivery of accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting for a publicly traded mortgage company. This role is responsible for SEC Reporting, regulatory filings and Accounting Policy.

The Director serves as a key leader within the Finance organization, partnering closely with Accounting Operations, Treasury, Capital Markets, Servicing, Originations, FP&A, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and External Audit teams to support high-quality financial reporting, internal controls, and strategic business initiatives.

This position plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity of the company’s financial statements, evaluating complex transactions,

Job Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the preparation and review of quarterly and annual SEC filings, including Forms 10-Q, 10-K, 8-K disclosures and supporting the earnings release process

  • Oversee the preparation and submission of recurring filings required by federal and state regulators, GSEs, warehouse lenders, investors, and other stakeholders.

  • Research and document accounting conclusions for complex accounting matters, including mortgage servicing rights, securitizations, debt transactions, acquisitions, fair value measurements, and other strategic transactions and business initiatives. .

  • Prepare and oversee statutory reporting for subsidiaries.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors, legal counsel, regulators, and internal stakeholders on financial reporting matters.

  • Partner with Internal Audit, SOX Compliance, Accounting Operations, and operational teams to maintain effective internal controls over financial reporting, including control documentation, testing support, remediation activities, and audit requests.

  • Lead the preparation of executive-level financial reporting packages, board support materials, earnings support, and other management reporting deliverables.

  • Drive process improvement, standardization, and automation initiatives across financial reporting processes to increase reporting accuracy, efficiency, scalability, and governance.

  • Promote best practices for reporting documentation, review procedures, data integrity, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop financial reporting professionals, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and professional development plans.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships with Accounting Operations, Treasury, Capital Markets, Servicing, Originations, FP&A, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Investor Relations, Tax, and External Audit teams

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must have the following education and/or experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.

  • CPA or equivalent required.

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience.

  • Minimum 3-5 years of leadership experience managing accounting or financial reporting teams.

  • Public company and SEC reporting experience required.

  • Mortgage banking, financial services, banking, or specialty finance industry experience strongly preferred.

  • Big 4 public accounting experience preferred.

  • Advanced knowledge of U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements and demonstrated ability to research and resolve complex accounting matters.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare financial statement disclosures and present complex information clearly and concisely to senior leaders.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications; experience with Oracle, Workiva Wdesk, SEC reporting software, or similar financial reporting platforms preferred

Training / Licensing Requirements:

  • Must pass the Company’s Background Screening process prior to beginning employment. Additionally, as a condition of employment, you may be required to pass client-specific background check requirements or Federal/State licensing requirements, if applicable.

  • The salary range for this position is expected to be $ 165k-190k per year, depending on geographic location, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.This position is also eligible for Bonus based on performance and subject to the terms of the company's applicable plans.

About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

About the Role

We’re looking for an AI Response Labeler / Annotator with deep expertise in Castilian Spanish and the cultural context of Spain.

This is an AI annotation and evaluation role, not a translation or traditional localization position. Castilian Spanish expertise is an essential specialization, but it represents only one component of the work. You’ll evaluate AI-generated responses across a broad range of topics, tasks, and real-world scenarios. Much of the content, annotation guidance, and day-to-day work will be in English.

You’ll perform side-by-side comparisons of responses generated by different AI models and determine which response better meets the user’s needs. This requires strong analytical judgment, the ability to interpret detailed guidelines, and the consistency to apply those standards across a high volume of evaluations.

Successful candidates will be comfortable assessing content beyond language quality alone. You may be asked to evaluate factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, reasoning, instruction-following, clarity, safety, tone, and overall usefulness.

What You'll Do

  • Perform side-by-side comparisons of AI-generated responses and determine which response is stronger.
  • Evaluate responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, clarity, reasoning, instruction-following, tone, and overall quality.
  • Assess content written in English, Castilian Spanish, or a combination of both, depending on the assigned scenario.
  • Evaluate a broad range of content, including general-purpose questions and answers, web-search results, file-based tasks, image-based responses, content-generation requests, and single-turn and multi-turn conversations.
  • Apply Castilian Spanish expertise when evaluating language, terminology, tone, regional conventions, idioms, and cultural context specific to Spain.
  • Evaluate the complete quality of a response rather than focusing only on grammar, translation, or language fluency.
  • Identify subtle but meaningful differences between responses, including unsupported claims, incomplete reasoning, missed instructions, unnatural phrasing, cultural inaccuracies, and differences in usefulness.
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines accurately and consistently.
  • Make independent evaluation decisions when examples or guidelines don’t provide an obvious answer.
  • Document decisions clearly and provide concise, evidence-based rationale when required.
  • Complete evaluations within established time and productivity expectations without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Maintain consistent judgment across a high volume of varied assignments.
  • Participate in training, guided practice, calibration sessions, qualification reviews, and ongoing quality-review activities.
  • Incorporate feedback and adjust evaluation decisions to remain aligned with team and client quality standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Native-level or professional fluency in Castilian Spanish.
  • Deep familiarity with the linguistic conventions, regional vocabulary, idioms, tone, and cultural context of Spanish as used in Spain.
  • Strong English fluency and reading comprehension, including the ability to understand complex prompts, AI-generated responses, and detailed annotation guidelines written in English.
  • Strong general analytical and critical-thinking skills that extend beyond language evaluation.
  • Ability to evaluate content across varied topics, formats, and task types.
  • Ability to assess factuality, relevance, reasoning, clarity, instruction-following, cultural appropriateness, and overall usefulness.
  • Ability to recognize subtle differences in meaning, quality, tone, and user intent.
  • Sound judgment when applying structured evaluation criteria to ambiguous or unfamiliar scenarios.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain evaluation decisions clearly and concisely.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while working within established time expectations.
  • Ability to learn and consistently apply detailed evaluation frameworks.
  • Ability to work independently while remaining aligned with shared quality standards.
  • Comfort performing repetitive, detail-oriented work for extended periods while maintaining focus, accuracy and consistent judgement.
  • Ability to receive feedback, recalibrate decisions, and adapt as evaluation guidelines evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performing side-by-side labeling, annotation, comparative content evaluation, or quality assessment.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated responses or contributing to model-quality assessment.
  • Experience with data labeling or annotation.
  • Experience evaluating search relevance, content quality, factual accuracy, or user-facing digital experiences.
  • Experience working with detailed guidelines, rubrics, or structured decision-making frameworks.

Work Pace and Productivity Expectations

This is a highly structured and repetitive role that involves completing similar evaluation tasks throughout the workday. Candidates should be comfortable maintaining focus, accuracy, and consistent judgment while reviewing a high volume of AI-generated content.

Most evaluation tasks are expected to take approximately 15 minutes, and employees are generally expected to complete a minimum of 25 tasks per day. Some tasks may take more or less time depending on their complexity.

Success in this role requires balancing productivity with quality. Employees must meet established daily expectations while carefully applying annotation guidelines and providing accurate, well-supported evaluation decisions.

Training and Qualification

All new hires must successfully complete a structured onboarding and qualification program before beginning production work.

The program includes training sessions, guided practice exercises, calibration against established quality benchmarks, and a formal qualification review.

Training is intended to establish consistent evaluation judgment across the team. Language fluency alone will not be sufficient to qualify. Employees must also demonstrate the ability to evaluate broader response quality, follow detailed annotation guidelines, explain their decisions, and complete work within the expected timeframe.

Employees will continue to receive feedback, quality reviews, and calibration support after entering production.

Compensation

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

The anticipated compensation range is $38.46 to $40.87 USD per hour, with a midpoint of $39.66 USD per hour. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Location and Work Arrangement

Remote within the United States.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and reside within a U.S. time zone.

During the approximately 30-day training and qualification period, employees must work from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time. After successfully completing training, employees may work standard business hours within their local time zone.

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

  • Write short and longform stories that help readers live and thrive in the Strathcona County region, and deliver understanding of the region for readers in the West.
