raw.description:
Онлайн-освіта - це територія динамічних стартапів та інвестицій. Cвітовий обсяг EdTech вже становить понад $400 мільярдів.

Ми, команда Laba Group, стартували 10 років тому — та вже є EdTech-лідерами в Східній Європі. У 2020 році ми вийшли на ринок Європи, й зараз активно працюємо над проєктами в Україні, Польщі, Румунії, Угорщині та Чехії.

За весь час ми запустили 1800+ курсів від експертів з таких компаній, як-от Google, Microsoft, Netflix та Nike.

Та створили 5 брендів онлайн-освіти:

Laba - сервіс професійного розвитку
Skvot - онлайн-школа популярної культури
robot_dreams - освітня платформа для зростання в ІТ
elvtr - платформа для креативної та корпоративної кар’єри в США і Великій Британії

Ми побудували AI-native процес створення онлайн-курсів.

Тепер шукаємо Продюсера онлайн-курсів, який працюватиме з цими продуктами та відповідатиме за фінальний результат.

Твоя основна задача — разом з АІ створювати якісні освітні продукти, які відповідають актуальному попиту ринку.

Для нас важливо не просто створити хороший курс. Важливо створити його тоді, коли він потрібен ринку.

Тому ця роль — про баланс трьох речей:

актуальність ринку × якість продукту × швидкість запуску.

AI виконує більшу частину пошукової, дослідницької та підготовчої роботи.

Ти — оцінюєш результат, приймаєш рішення, працюєш із лектором і доводиш продукт до високої якості.

Requirements

Твої майбутні задачі:

  • Працювати з нашими AI-продуктами.
  • Оцінювати теми та продуктові гіпотези, які знаходить AI.
  • Перевіряти й челенджити результати AI.
  • Вибирати сильних лекторів.
  • Вести переговори до фінальної домовленості.
  • Доводити програму до потрібної якості.

Важливо: ми оцінюватимемо не кількість проведених досліджень або створених документів, а якість продуктів і швидкість, з якою вони доходять до ринку.

Кого шукаємо:

Продуктове мислення

  • Ти вмієш дивитися на тему очима ринку й аудиторії. Розумієш різницю між цікавою ідеєю та продуктом, за який треба ринку саме зараз.

Сильний judgment

  • Умієш працювати з великою кількістю згенерованої інформації, бачити сильні сигнали, знаходити суперечності та приймати рішення. Не потребуєш повної визначеності, щоб рухатися вперед.

Швидкість

  • Не перетворюєш дослідження та створення програми на нескінченний процес. Умієш визначити, коли результат уже достатньо сильний для наступного кроку, і не затягуєш рішення через прагнення до абстрактної досконалості.

Високі стандарти якості

  • Швидкість для тебе не означає поверхневість. Ти можеш швидко помітити слабку концепцію, недостатньо сильного лектора або програму, яка не дасть студенту потрібного результату.

Переговори та комунікація

  • Тобі комфортно написати незнайомому засновнику, C-level керівнику або сильному галузевому експерту. Ти можеш зацікавити людину ідеєю, провести зустріч, відпрацювати заперечення та домовитися про співпрацю.

Що для нас означає AI-Native:

Ми не шукаємо людину, яка просто вміє писати промпти або час від часу користується ChatGPT.

І також не очікуємо, що ти самостійно побудуєш усі необхідні AI-інструменти — вони вже є.

Нам потрібна людина, яка:

  • швидко опанує наші AI-продукти;
  • використовуватиме їх як основний робочий інструмент;
  • умітиме правильно спрямовувати систему;
  • перевірятиме її висновки;
  • помічатиме слабкі місця;
  • даватиме зворотний зв’язок для покращення флоу;
  • не виконуватиме вручну те, що вже може зробити AI;
  • не передаватиме AI відповідальність за фінальне рішення.

AI створює швидкість і масштаб. Ти забезпечуєш якість і правильний вибір.

Буде плюсом:

  • досвід створення освітніх або digital-продуктів;
  • досвід у переговорах;
  • досвід у стартапах або іншому динамічному середовищі;
  • робота з AI-продуктами, агентами чи автоматизованими процесами.

Нам не принципово, як називалася твоя попередня посада.

Важливіше, чи вмієш ти бачити ринкову можливість, приймати рішення, домовлятися з людьми та створювати якісний продукт.

Benefits

Що ми пропонуємо:

  • віддалений формат роботи;
  • доступ до всіх курсів Laba Group для тебе та твоїх рідних після чотирьох місяців роботи;
  • компенсацію навчання, спорту, техніки та ментального здоров’я;
  • оплачувані лікарняні;
  • оплачувану відпустку;
  • реальні можливості кар’єрного розвитку;
  • команду, яка підтримає і в робочих задачах, і мемами ❤️

Тепер ти знаєш про нас більше.

А ми хочемо дізнатися більше про тебе: заповнюй коротку форму — і го розвивати EdTech разом

raw.title: Senior Software Developer - Simulation
raw.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
raw.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

Modern engineering teams invest a significant amount of time and money on simulation. Before anything gets built, teams need confidence that a design is going to work: structurally, thermally, aerodynamically, etc. Simulation is one of the main ways they build that confidence.

But the way teams share and review simulation results to make decisions is still pretty broken. Engineers are exporting videos, taking screenshots, dropping them into PowerPoint, and then trying to make decisions through email threads, meetings, or disconnected slide decks. The actual decision-making ends up separated from the underlying simulation data, which means context gets lost, feedback is hard to trace, and important engineering knowledge disappears into the workflow.

CoLab already helps engineering teams review CAD, capture feedback, and make better design decisions in one connected workspace. Now we’re extending that same idea into simulation. The goal is simple: make simulation results collaborative, reviewable, and traceable in the same way CoLab does for CAD today.

We’re starting a new product team focused on bringing simulation review into CoLab. As one of the first engineers on that team, you’ll help define how simulation data gets ingested, visualized, discussed, and connected back to real engineering decisions. There are a lot of interesting technical problems here: large datasets, high-performance visualization, viewer interactions, data pipelines, and user experiences that need to work for mechanical engineers doing critical product development work.

The first phase is about learning the product, the customers, and the review workflows we already support today. You’ll spend time embedded with our Engineering Reviews team, learning how engineers collaborate in CoLab, where the current product is strong, and where simulation creates a new set of problems we need to solve. From there, you’ll help build the foundation for a new Simulation team - not just technically, but from a product perspective as well. We want to build something customers actually need and will use in their day-to-day work, and that requires a highly product oriented approach.

Our Ideal Candidate

You're the kind of developer who wants to understand why a feature matters before deciding how to build it.

You enjoy owning complex technical problems, but you also enjoy talking with product managers, designers, and customers to understand what success actually looks like. You make thoughtful technical decisions independently and know when to bring others into the conversation.

Experience working with simulation software is a significant advantage. Maybe you've worked with FEA, CFD, multiphysics simulations, scientific visualization, or engineering data platforms. You understand the kinds of problems engineers are trying to solve.

This is a good fit for someone who likes ambiguity, wants to work closely with our product and leadership teams, and cares about the connection between technical decisions and customer value. You’ll have a meaningful role in shaping both the architecture and the user experience for a new capability that we think can become a major part of engineering review in CoLab.

What You'll Do

  • Help design and build CoLab's next-generation simulation review capabilities.
  • Build services that ingest and process simulation data from industry-standard engineering software.
  • Develop high-performance visualization experiences capable of displaying large simulation datasets.
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, and customers to validate ideas before building them.
  • Spend time embedded with the Engineering Reviews team to develop deep product and customer understanding before transitioning onto the Simulation team.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that will shape this product area for years to come.
  • Improve performance, scalability, and reliability as simulation capabilities grow.
  • Collaborate with engineers across the platform to ensure simulation becomes a seamless part of the broader CoLab experience.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone with:

  • 8+ years building production software in a modern engineering environment.
  • Strong experience designing scalable backend systems and customer-facing applications.
  • Experience building complex data visualization or graphics-intensive applications.
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with teammates.
  • A product mindset - you think about customer outcomes as much as technical implementation.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex ideas clearly.
  • Experience with Finite Element Analysis (FEA), CFD, or other CAE workflows.
  • Experience with engineering simulation platforms
  • Experience with CAD, PLM, or engineering software development.
  • Large engineering datasets and high-performance rendering.

The Extra Details

  • Full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package, including stock options.
  • Extended health benefits, unlimited paid vacation, and RRSP/401K matching.
  • Remote-first across North America

Equity Note

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification - your potential is what matters most to us.

raw.description:
See your work in a new light.

At LUX Infusion, we’re reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected. Inspired by lux—meaning light - we guide patients, providers, and partners through complex therapies with clarity, compassion, and confidence.

As a clinician-led, U.S.-based organization, we put people first - helping patients feel seen and supported through faster therapy starts, dedicated care coordination, and meaningful collaboration. Our commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and advancement (IDEA) is central to our culture, ensuring every team member feels valued and empowered to make a difference.

We’re looking for a Reimbursement Specialist who wants their work to mean something — someone who brings care, accountability, and precision to every claim they touch.

Why This Role Matters

This role plays an important part in helping LUX Infusion deliver a patient‑first experience by ensuring accurate, timely reimbursement so patients can access care without unnecessary delays or financial confusion.

In this role, you’ll contribute to work that:

  • Helps patients receive life‑sustaining therapies without disruption
  • Supports clinicians, pharmacy teams, and care coordinators through reliable billing and reimbursement processes
  • Strengthens the financial foundation of a growing, clinician‑led organization focused on long‑term patient outcomes

Every claim represents a real person managing a complex condition — and this role helps remove barriers so care can continue seamlessly.

Role Details

Schedule:
8:30am – 5:00pm CST or EST

Location:
This role is remote .
Work location is subject to change based on business needs.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities include:

  • Ensure accurate and timely billing and reimbursement by submitting clean claims to primary and secondary payers
  • Review, correct, and resubmit rejected or denied claims promptly
  • Verify insurance eligibility, authorizations, and documentation prior to medication delivery
  • Maintain complete and accurate patient billing files, including CMNs, prescriptions, and supporting medical documentation
  • Confirm delivery dates before claim submission and invoice patients for applicable responsibility amounts
  • Serve as a key partner to pharmacy, care coordination, and field staff to resolve billing issues
  • Track accounts receivable activity and maintain detailed AR status reporting
  • Communicate regularly with insurance companies, providers, and internal teams regarding claim status
  • Predict cash flow based on claim progression and payer response patterns
  • Maintain documentation of all payer communications and follow‑ups
  • Respond to payer requests for records, authorizations, and clinical documentation in a timely manner
  • Support insurance contract maintenance and payer audits as needed
  • Monitor trends in payer behavior, coverage changes, and industry updates, escalating concerns appropriately
  • Participate in quality assurance activities, audits, training, and continuing education initiatives
  • Bring reliability, organization, and follow‑through to a fast‑paced revenue cycle environment

What We’re Looking For

You may be a great fit if you bring:

  • Deep care about how billing accuracy impacts patient access and experience
  • At least two years of medical insurance or reimbursement experience
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills
  • Comfort working with billing systems, payer portals, and Microsoft Office tools
  • Strong customer service mindset and professionalism when resolving complex payer issues
  • Ability to stay organized and adaptable amid changing workloads

Preferred (but not required):

  • Home infusion or specialty pharmacy reimbursement experience
  • Familiarity with CPR+ and/or CareTend systems
  • Certified Pharmacy Technician credentials
  • Experience supporting patients with chronic or rare conditions

You don’t need to check every box — we care just as much about how thoughtfully you approach your work as your specific background.

Why LUX Infusion

At LUX Infusion, we believe infusion care deserves more light — more warmth, more clarity, and more connection.

Here, you’ll find:

  • Purpose‑driven work that directly supports patient care
  • A patient‑first, clinician‑led culture
  • Collaborative teams across pharmacy, revenue cycle, and care coordination
  • Opportunities to grow your expertise in specialty infusion reimbursement

Come help us elevate infusion care — and see what’s possible when accuracy, empathy, and accountability come together.

Pay Range/Rate
$23—$27 USD

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here represent those required for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact the LUX Infusion Talent Team at or 954.385.7322 x 1425.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, or sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee may also be required to occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this role include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Employees are expected to:

  • Participate annually in required legal and ethical compliance training
  • Consistently act in compliance with LUX Infusion’s legal, ethical, and compliance policies
  • Adhere to all standards and procedures outlined in the LUX Infusion Compliance Manual
  • Refrain from any behavior that could be considered unethical or unlawful

EXPECTATIONS FOR ALL EMPLOYEES

All LUX Infusion team members are expected to support the organization’s mission, vision, and values by demonstrating integrity, dedication, compassion, and enthusiasm. This includes placing patients first, working collaboratively with a “stacked‑hands” mindset, and maintaining a consistent focus on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

GENERAL INFORMATION

The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals in this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required.

This role operates in a fast‑paced environment and requires the ability to prioritize competing demands, manage multiple tasks effectively, and seek guidance when appropriate.

Employees in this position may be required to assist directly - or coordinate appropriate assistance - to ensure access to LUX Infusion’s services for individuals with disabilities, including patients, visitors, employees, or others.

raw.title: Head of Engineering, POS Application Platform
raw.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
raw.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why South Africa

South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is close to home.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, POS Apps to join us in South Africa.

About the role

More than 6 million businesses run their financial lives through Moniepoint - and the primary way they interact with us every single day is through a POS device. For most of our merchants, that device is their business. It is how they accept payments, how they access credit, and how they track their finances. Everything those devices are capable of, in terms of speed, reliability, and developer quality, flows from the engineering platform this role leads.

We are building a dedicated POS Application Platform function: the foundational Kotlin-based engineering layer that sits beneath every POS product at Moniepoint. Think of it as the operating system for our POS engineering organisation - the standards, frameworks, tooling, and architectural backbone that every POS engineer across the business builds on top of. This is not a feature team. It is a platform team in the truest sense, and the Head of Engineering for POS Application Platform is the technical owner of that layer.

We currently operate across five POS device types from multiple OEM manufacturers, all running on Android. The engineering challenges here span device governance, developer experience, platform reliability, foundational frameworks, and adoption across a distributed set of POS engineers working in separate product squads.

And the scope is growing. We have a UK entity live, a cross-border payments product in market, and a microfinance bank acquisition which just finalized in Kenya. The platform you build will become the foundation for tens of millions of businesses across multiple markets to accept payments, access financial services, and grow. If you have spent your career going deep on POS systems and you want to build the platform that underpins one of Africa's most consequential fintech businesses during its expansion, this is the role.

What you'll get to do

  • Own the technical strategy and architecture for the POS Application Platform, acting as the domain CTO for everything that runs on our POS devices.
  • Build and govern the four core platform pillars across the organisation: developer experience (tools, libraries, SDKs), platform reliability (observability, uptime, quality standards), foundational frameworks (architecture, coding standards, testing and release pipelines), and squad adoption (driving uptake of platform tooling across all embedded POS engineers).
  • Define and enforce engineering standards across all POS device types and OEM manufacturers, ensuring architectural consistency and quality across a heterogeneous device fleet.
  • Functionally lead POS engineers embedded across Payments, Onboarding, VAS, Savings, and Loans squads - setting the bar for engineering quality and providing the platform layer above all of them.
  • Own POS observability end-to-end: monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks that ensure platform health across all devices and squads.
  • Drive the architecture for how Moniepoint supports multiple POS device types, including defining how new devices are onboarded, governed, and integrated with the platform.
  • Collaborate with OEM partners and the POS hardware team when new device types are introduced, ensuring the application layer is ready to support them from day one.
  • Build and scale the POS platform team, including hiring, mentoring, and structuring for growth as the platform expands internationally.
  • Translate platform decisions into business impact, working closely with Product, Payments, and Business leadership across markets.
  • Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, tooling standards, CI/CD pipelines, and developer productivity metrics across the POS engineering community.

To succeed in this role, we think you should have

  • A minimum of 10 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 6 years leading engineering teams through meaningful growth phases, ideally in multi-national or large VC-backed companies.
  • Direct, hands-on experience building software that runs on Point-of-Sale terminal devices. This means engineering on the device itself — the application layer — not server-side integrations with POS systems. This is a non-negotiable requirement and candidates without it will not be considered.
  • Strong working knowledge of EMV standards (Europay, Mastercard, Visa) and experience navigating payment certification processes such as PCI DSS and P2PE. Candidates without this will not be considered.
  • Deep Android engineering expertise in Kotlin and Java. The POS application layer at Moniepoint is Android-based and there are no exceptions to this requirement.
  • Proven experience building internal engineering platforms, shared libraries, developer tooling, or foundational frameworks used by other engineering teams — not just consumer-facing feature products.
  • Experience governing or architecting across multiple POS device types from different hardware manufacturers, with an understanding of how OEM integrations and device management work at scale.
  • Experience building or maturing platform engineering functions, including establishing engineering processes, tooling strategies, and cross-squad governance structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to scale engineering teams and build the organisational layer beneath you — leaders who can grow into and around the role you are hiring into.
  • Experience at a company processing high volumes of financial transactions in a regulated environment. Fintech background is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with terminal management systems and device observability tooling is a strong advantage.
  • Backend engineering experience in Java or Spring Boot is a strong plus given the breadth of the platform and the integration surface it sits on.
  • Experience working directly with OEM vendors on hardware specification and integration is a bonus.
  • Exposure to C or C++ is a plus — one of our device variants uses C.
  • Experience at Series A or B stage startups alone is unlikely to reflect the scale and complexity required for this role.

Cultural Alignment

We assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Deep empathy for the people depending on the platform — whether that is a merchant in Lagos trying to accept a payment, or a POS engineer blocked by missing tooling. You solve problems quickly and intuitively. You close loops by fixing root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: You have mastered your domain at the fundamentals level. You make trade-offs explicit, reason from first principles, and consistently produce solutions that are better than typical.
  • Systemisation: You convert recurring decisions into repeatable mechanisms. You reduce cognitive load for others. You strengthen institutional memory and improve engineering quality at scale.
  • Urgency: You move with disciplined speed. You act without waiting for permission when you are within scope. You escalate early when risk exceeds your authority. You remove friction and close loops.
  • Ownership: You treat the platform as yours to solve regardless of job description boundaries. You take responsibility without being asked. You follow through on commitments without being reminded.
  • No Ego: You put the mission ahead of personal status. You credit others genuinely, welcome challenge, and never protect your position at the expense of collective outcomes.
  • Candour: You surface reality early, clearly, and completely — especially when it is uncomfortable. You name risks before they become crises. Intelligent failure is acceptable; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Truthfulness and ethical consistency in everything. You adhere to rules and obligations. You never perform under intimidation or corrosive behaviour. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

Some of the technologies you'll work with

  • Android (Kotlin, Java) - primary platform for all POS application development
  • EMV payment standards and PCI/P2PE certification frameworks
  • Multiple POS device types and OEM manufacturers, including Topwise and Telpo
  • Terminal management systems and device observability tooling
  • Java, Spring Boot — backend services and integration layer
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch
  • Microservices architecture on AWS

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You will receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • Stage 1: A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
  • Stage 2: Technical Round focused on core technical strengths and depth in Android/Kotlin
  • Stage 3: System Design - You will be asked to solve complex system design problems to assess your technical and architectural skills, with a particular focus on POS and mobile platform architecture and payment systems.
  • Stage 4: Technical and Architectural Leadership - An interview with one Head of Engineering focused on leadership skills and attributes.
  • Stage 5: CTO Interview - A conversation with our CTO assessing first-principles thinking, problem-solving under ambiguity, clarity of thought, and cultural alignment.

How to apply: Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile via our career website.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates!

WSA is a global leader in the hearing aid industry. Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

At HearUSA, our mission is to reframe the world of hearing care and set the highest standard in modern hearing health. With an extensive network of 4,000 independent Hearing Care Professionals and more than 350 centers in U.S., we strive every day to provide each individual with the care, knowledge and experience they deserve.

What it’s all about:

As a Client Experience Specialist, you are passionate about the hearing healthcare of our clients. You will ensure clients’ needs are met in a timely manner, maintain a well-organized appointment schedule, and prioritize Simply Excellent Hearing Care.

What’s in it for you?

  • Top priority of culture and community including ongoing training

  • Attractive compensation package with monthly bonus opportunities

  • Onboarding, comprehensive benefits, paid holidays, PTO, 401k with match, Health & Wellness programs

  • Mentorship and professional development opportunities including a CES Advisory Board

  • Field support for your hearing center

What you will do:

  • Maintain client charts and ensure information is up to date

  • Prioritize welcome and confirmation calls and provide friendly and enthusiastic customer service

  • Manages clinic schedule to ensure efficient and expedient patient care for walk-in/curbside appointments, scheduled appointments, and potential clients

  • Enter stock and custom orders, perform weekly inventory audit to ensure accuracy.

  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of cash and bank deposits and perform all end of day processes and reports/ settlements

  • Maintains a clean, inviting, and friendly environment

  • Maintain basic knowledge of hearing aid technology and be able to perform basic cleaning/repair functions

  • Assist with basic hearing aid trouble shooting via telephone or in-person and clean and checks

  • Maintain knowledge of current HearUSA's products, promotions and pricing. As needed, facilitate and support with HearAssist and remote care

What we are looking for:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • Experience in customer service and office administration

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, ability to establish and maintain a professional rapport with clients and co-workers

  • Proficiency with computers including scheduling software and MS Office

  • Strong multi-tasking, organization, and time-management skills

A Place to Grow your Career:

Growth means investing in employee development, from day-to-day support to opportunities to stretch your skills. It also means creating space for your voice, sharing knowledge, and learning from peers as we build culture and community together. We offer:

  • A professional development team of dedicated Regional Training Managers

  • Continuing education, LinkedIn Learning and tuition reimbursement

  • Career advancement pathways for Center Support and Client Care

Pays :$19hr

raw.description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We are on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need talented people to help make our vision a reality.

We are spearheading the transition to greener, cheaper energy through the installation of in-home technologies, from smart meters and electric vehicle chargers to low-carbon heating, home batteries, and solar PV. Harnessing our technology platform, we deliver smart energy solutions that help decarbonise homes worldwide.

This role sits at the commercial heart of that mission. As a Procurement Manager, you'll own end-to-end procurement accountability for one of our critical residential low-carbon technology categories, with direct impact on install revenue, hardware margin, supply continuity, and the pace at which we decarbonise homes at scale.

What you'll do

    • Own end-to-end procurement accountability for one of our residential low-carbon technology categories - Heat Pumps, EV Chargers, or Solar & Battery Storage - a strategically critical spend portfolio directly linked to £100M+ in revenue.

    • Build and deliver a category strategy that improves hardware margin through strategic sourcing, supplier renegotiation, direct sourcing expansion, value engineering, and tail spend control - contributing to a stretching multi-year cost reduction commitment tracked monthly against P&L.

    • Secure supply continuity through dual-source arrangements, removing single points of failure, and proactive supplier risk management.

    • Own supplier commercial performance and governance across your category: contract negotiation and renewal, supplier segmentation, monthly and quarterly business reviews on strategic partners, and clear escalation ownership when things move.

    • Partner closely with our Planning function through weekly Materials Reviews and S&OP forums, ensuring inbound material availability is planned and executed against a single integrated operational plan, and variances are managed commercial.
    • Partner with Technical, Operations, Finance, Commercial, and Product to land new product introductions, improve working capital, and develop creative commercial solutions that give customers better products at lower cost.

What you'll need

    • Commercial and supplier-facing experience in direct procurement, ideally within residential low-carbon technology (heat pumps, solar, battery, EV) or adjacent categories such as HVAC, white goods, or building products.

    • Proven track record of leading end-to-end sourcing and delivering multi-million pound cost reduction against committed targets in supplier-facing commercial roles.

    • Genuine commercial sharpness. You understand supplier P&Ls, cost breakdowns, market drivers, and where commercial leverage exists. You can spot shifts in input costs, capacity, or supplier risk early and turn that judgment into commercial action.

    • Direct experience of low-cost country sourcing including Asian supply markets.

    • Self-directing. Comfortable owning your category with clear commercial outcomes rather than close oversight.

    • Resilience and non-conformist instincts. We push boundaries, challenge market norms, and take routes others won't.

    • Prioritisation under load. You'll balance category strategy, live supplier issues, cross-functional projects, and transformation contribution.
    • Willingness to travel to suppliers and manufacturing sites, including international travel to key production regions - expect around one week per month on average, weighted toward supplier engagement, factory audits, and category development.

Why else you'll love it here

• Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
• Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were named the UK's top company to work for in 2025, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
• Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you, tell us what you care about, why Octopus feels right and most importantly, bring us the real you! Applying for jobs can be a bit scary so have a nose through some of our tips first🚀

raw.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Principal Product Designer – Infrastructure

Your opportunity

As a Principal Product Designer on New Relic's Infrastructure design team, you'll set the design vision for how engineers understand and operate the systems underneath their applications — cloud environments, Kubernetes, hosts, network performance (including eBPF-based instrumentation), and databases, partnering directly with VP- and SVP-level engineering and product leadership to shape a roadmap with measurable business impact. You'll work across the US and India to turn dense infrastructure telemetry into interfaces that hold up when something is actually on fire.

We care more about how you think than what you've already shipped. This role is built for someone with genuine, demonstrated curiosity about how complex technical systems work — someone who has a track record of digging into unfamiliar domains, asking good questions of engineers, and building real fluency rather than treating the underlying technology as a black box. Direct observability experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. The expectation for this role is someone who generates the ideas required to solve a problem even when it's ambiguous, and who leads through that complexity rather than waiting for someone else to define it.

You'll set craft and design-system standards across the Infrastructure design team, mentor senior and mid-level designers beyond a single direct pod, and be a visible design leader recognized by teams inside and outside the department as we evolve how we use AI in our own design workflow. This is a remote role based in India, working in close daily overlap with a US-based team.

What you'll do

  • Infrastructure & complex data visualization: Design dashboards and visualizations that make cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database telemetry legible — reducing cognitive load for engineers troubleshooting under pressure.
  • System coherence & fail-safe UX: Champion coherence across the Infrastructure surface, designing interaction patterns that guide platform engineers and SREs safely through incident response and root-cause investigation.
  • Own the product vision: Lead the creation of new product vision for Infrastructure with a clear line to business revenue impact, serving as the primary design point of contact across product, engineering, and go-to-market.
  • Go deep on the technology: Build real fluency in the systems you're designing for — cloud architecture, container orchestration, network protocols, eBPF, database internals — through direct conversations with engineers, hands-on exploration, and a genuine appetite for the technical detail most designers skip.
  • User research: Plan and run interviews and usability testing with SREs, platform engineers, and DevOps practitioners to validate design direction and keep the roadmap grounded in how these users actually work.
  • AI-forward evolution: Partner with engineering and product to bring AI-assisted diagnostics and anomaly detection into the infrastructure experience, applying the same curiosity to new AI tooling that you bring to the underlying systems.
  • Team leadership & craft: Set the craft bar across Infrastructure design, mentor senior and mid-level designers, and represent the team's design perspective directly to VP and SVP stakeholders.
  • Design at scale: Drive large-scale, cross-team design initiatives within Infrastructure, and partner with principal designers across Product Platform and Growth & Monetization to keep the broader platform coherent as it expands.

This role requires

  • 12+ years of professional experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio showing complex, data-heavy B2B SaaS or enterprise work.
  • Demonstrated, innate curiosity about technology — evidence that you've taught yourself unfamiliar technical domains in past roles, not just applied design process to whatever was handed to you.
  • Experience designing for technical personas (software engineers, SREs, DevOps, platform engineers), or a clear, credible path to ramping into this audience quickly.
  • Real skill in user research: interviews, usability testing, and synthesis that changes product direction, not just validates it.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to component-based design systems at scale, including a demonstrated ability to design systems-level solutions rather than instance by instance.
  • Solid grasp of WCAG 2.1 AA and assistive technologies, with the ability to independently troubleshoot accessibility issues and mentor others on accessible design practices.
  • Ability to connect design work to business outcomes — mapping initiatives to KPIs/OKRs and making the case for design decisions in terms product and engineering partners respect, including a track record of tying design work to measurable revenue impact, not just usability metrics.
  • Strong written and verbal English, and comfort working with a distributed team across US and India time zones.
  • A track record operating independently across multiple teams in a complex environment, with real experience partnering directly with VP- or SVP-level stakeholders on strategic initiatives.
  • An external professional presence in the design community — conferences, writing, mentorship beyond New Relic — consistent with the seniority of this level.

Bonus points if you have

  • Direct experience in observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), or adjacent developer-facing tooling.
  • Prior exposure to designing for AI-assisted or LLM-based tools, and comfort prototyping with AI-native tools (Figma AI, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
  • A working understanding of frontend fundamentals (HTML, CSS, React) that makes engineering handoff smoother.
  • Strong facilitation skills for cross-functional design sprints and workshops.

BUSINESS GOALS

This hire addresses cognitive overload during infrastructure incident response — the gap between a high-level "something's wrong" signal and the granular cloud, cluster, host, network, or database trace that explains why. As New Relic's Infrastructure suite absorbs more surface area (AI-agent observability, expanding eBPF coverage, deeper database monitoring), we need a design leader who can set a portfolio-level vision for that complexity — one with a credible line to business revenue and adoption, not just a well-designed feature. The end goal is the same one driving the whole design org right now: bringing AI into the diagnostic workflow to cut customer mean-time-to-resolution.

What are the key milestones or business outcomes this person must deliver in Year 1 to be considered a successful hire?

  1. Unify infrastructure workflows: audit and connect monitoring and mitigation pathways across cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database surfaces, establishing a portfolio-level design vision with measurable adoption and revenue impact, not just shared visual patterns.
  2. AI-assisted diagnostics: deliver initial UX architecture and human-in-the-loop interaction models for AI-assisted anomaly detection and root-cause analysis in Infrastructure.
  3. Process maturation: help standardize cross-functional design review between design, product, and engineering on complex telemetry pipelines (OpenTelemetry, eBPF-based instrumentation).
  4. Research cadence: stand up a continuous research loop with SREs and platform engineers to keep the roadmap grounded in real operating conditions, not assumptions.
  5. Executive partnership: build a working relationship with VP/SVP engineering and product leadership, and with peer principal designers across Product Platform and Growth & Monetization, so Infrastructure's design vision holds together with the rest of the platform.

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.

Our hiring process

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.

Symetra has an exciting opportunity to join our team as an Investment Reporting Analyst within our Investment Reporting Team!

About the role

As an Investment Reporting Analyst, you will support Symetra Investment Management Co.’s (“SIM”) investment close and reporting cycles. You’ll work closely with senior analysts to prepare investment reports, assist in valuation and performance procedures, and learn how to translate financial data into clear, meaningful insights for internal and external stakeholders.

This role is designed for an early-career professional interested in investment reporting, portfolio analytics, BI tools, performance measurement and data-driven analysis. You will receive training and mentorship to build both technical and analytical capabilities. Over time, you’ll gain experience with valuation workflows, alternative investments, and business intelligence tools that support SIM’s expanding reporting needs.

At certain times—such as quarter-end—additional hours may be required. Overall, SIM offers strong work-life balance and a collaborative, flexible environment.

Company Overview

Symetra Investment Management (“SIM”) is a SEC-registered investment advisory firm with approximately $94 billion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026. Symetra Financial Corporation (“SFC”), a diversified financial services company with $77.9 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025, headquartered in Bellevue, Washington is the sole shareholder of SIM. SFC is also the holding company of Symetra Life Insurance Company (“Symetra Life”), which was founded in 1957, and has insurer financial strength ratings of ‘A’ by A.M. Best and Standard & Poor’s and ‘A1’ by Moody’s. Symetra Life is among the top 40 largest life insurance companies in the United States (based on statutory admitted assets as of December 31, 2025) and has approximately 5.5 million customers and over 3,200 employees nationwide. SFC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Sumitomo Life Insurance Company, a mutual life insurance company with head offices in Osaka and Tokyo, Japan. Founded in 1907, Sumitomo is one of the largest life insurance companies in Japan with $323 billion of assets as of March 31, 2026. SIM has recently begun marketing its investment management services to third-party institutional investors.

Your responsibilities

  • Prepare recurring investment reports with guidance from senior team members, including monthly portfolio summaries and materials for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support reporting for alternative and private market assets, including gathering data, performing checks, and preparing components of recurring reporting packages.
  • Assist with the valuation process, including validations, reconciliation of market and pricing data, and reviewing inputs for alternative and fixed income assets after receiving training.
  • Support performance reconciliations, data collection and help maintain the accuracy of pricing and market data across investment systems.
  • Contribute to enhancements of existing reports and support the development of new tools as your skills growth.
  • Collaborate with internal teams in Investments, Finance, and Operations to gather information needed for reporting and analysis.
  • Learn and use technology such as Excel, PowerBI, and SQL to improve reporting efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Help maintain accurate procedural documentation for reporting and valuation workflows.

Your education and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Management Information Systems, Data Science or Computer Science
  • 0–3 years of relevant experience (internships, academic projects, or coursework welcome).
  • Exposure to investment concepts, financial reporting, or data analysis
  • Prior experience in reporting, alternative investments and/or investment valuation is helpful, but not required.
  • Bonus skills / willingness to learn
    • Experience using SimCorp Dimension and/or Clearwater accounting system
    • Experience in PowerBI, SQL, stored procedures, relational databases, and/or data warehousing/marts

Your skills and abilities

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, with the desire to learn and apply new financial and data concepts.
  • Interest in building a career in investment reporting, analytics, or portfolio support.
  • Great teammate who can work both independently and in a team environment; cross-train and cover for colleagues; be a culture carrier.
  • Able to prioritize and meet deadlines, recognizing when assistance or resources are needed and escalate as necessary. Occasionally available to work nights and weekends based on business requirements.
  • Strong Excel and data management skills with interest in expanding technical capabilities over time.
  • This is a remote role with required travel to the Farmington, CT office for in-person events a few times per year.

What we offer you

Benefits and Perks

We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
  • Want more details? Check out ourSymetra Benefits Overview
We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.
For more information about our careers visit:
Work Authorization
Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.
Please review Symetra's Remote Network Minimum Requirements:
As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees' internet connection:
  • Minimum Internet Speed:100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
  • Internet Type:Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
  • Not Permissible:Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.
When applying to jobs at Symetra you'll be asked to test your internet speed and confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra's standard as outlined above.

Identity Verification

Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. For all roles, candidates will be required (after the initial phone screen) to be on video for all interviews. Symetra will take affirmative steps at key points in the process to verify that a candidate is not seeking employment fraudulently, e.g. through use of a false identity.

Data and Integration Engineer (AI and Automation)

Job Overview

Our client is a UK-based managed service provider delivering technology and operational services to customers in the Accountancy, Financial Services, and Asset Management sectors. They are looking for a hands-on Data and Integration Engineer (AI and Automation) to own and develop the integration capability connecting their service, commercial, financial, and operational systems.

The role will focus on API integration engineering, data quality, automation, reporting, and the secure integration of AI capabilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for building reliable, well-documented, and supportable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the quality and accessibility of business data.

Job Details
Work Setup: Work from Home
Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | UK Time
Holidays: Will follow UK holidays

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain API integrations between business systems, including two-way synchronization between platforms and integration with the central data layer.
  • Build integrations with appropriate error handling, alerting, and reconciliation checks to ensure broken or partial data feeds are identified promptly.
  • Automate recurring manual processes across finance and operations, including scheduled extracts, reconciliation support, and supplier billing, using auditable and reproducible processes.
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues at source, including entity matching across customer, accounting, and CRM records, and implement controls to prevent recurring issues.
  • Contribute to the design and development of the central data warehouse, including staging layer design, entity matching, incremental loading, and history handling.
  • Work with finance and operations stakeholders to develop reports and dashboards based on the central data layer.
  • Build AI-assisted workflows where they can measurably improve business throughput and use AI development tools to accelerate engineering work.
  • Gather requirements directly from non-technical stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations and translate business needs into clear written specifications.
  • Assess vendor APIs and develop secure, reliable integration solutions for both existing and unfamiliar systems.
  • Work with production constraints such as permissions, rate limits, limited schema access, and differences between vendor documentation and actual endpoint behaviour.
  • Ensure solutions are documented, monitored, supportable, and maintained using disciplined development and source-control practices.
  • Follow the established delivery process, including planning, scope definition, pre-sales authorization, peer review, documentation, and go-live activities.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting API integrations between business systems in a production environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of REST, OAuth2, and webhooks.
  • Experience with two-way synchronization, including understanding of write conflicts, retries, idempotency, and reconciliation.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Graph, Entra APIs, or comparable vendor APIs.
  • Ability to work with real-world production constraints, including permission limitations, rate limits, restricted schema access, and inconsistent API behaviour.
  • Strong SQL skills, including queries, joins, views, and stored procedures.
  • Experience with Power Query, including ETL, data transformation, and M language.
  • Experience automating recurring processes end-to-end, including scheduling, monitoring, and failure handling.
  • Practical experience using AI coding tools within a reviewed workflow, with the ability to verify and validate AI-generated output.
  • Experience building and delivering reports and dashboards for business users using Power BI or a comparable reporting tool.
  • Ability to translate reporting requirements from non-technical stakeholders into working and documented outputs.
  • Understanding of how the underlying data model affects reporting capabilities and limitations.
  • Strong focus on accuracy, reconciliation, and traceability of data back to its source.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to finance professionals and business concepts to technical colleagues.
  • Self-starter who can work independently with direction from the Finance Director.
  • Ability to gather requirements directly from business stakeholders and work effectively with colleagues who may have limited data-related knowledge.
  • Willingness to identify and communicate when a solution cannot be implemented safely.
  • Strong documentation and working practices, including maintaining work in shared workspaces and source control.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, particularly in orchestrating AI services over a data platform and understanding how models and APIs are selected and governed.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and pipelines, with an understanding of capacity and licensing costs.
  • Experience delivering a data warehouse or lakehouse, including staging layer design, dimensional modelling, incremental loading, and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Working knowledge of data governance concepts such as sensitivity labelling, Microsoft Purview, access control, and data classification.
  • Experience integrating accounting platforms such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, or NetSuite with reporting tools or downstream systems.
  • Experience with PSA/MSP platforms such as Halo PSA, ConnectWise, Autotask, or Datto.
  • Exposure to IT Glue, Liongard, or Scalepad.
  • Advanced Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic models, star schema design, and Power BI Service administration.
  • Experience in an MSP, professional services, or project-based business where billable utilization and project margin are important.
  • Experience with low-code automation tools such as Power Automate or Zapier, with the judgment to determine when low-code is more appropriate than custom development.

raw.description:
StellarTech builds and publishes B2C mobile subscription apps in edtech, and our growth runs on performance marketing at scale. As the business grows, more and more of what matters happens between teams: Growth, Marketing, Monetization, Creative Production, Product, Analytics, Platform and Payments. That is exactly where this role sits.

We are looking for a Senior Operations Manager who can take a complex, unstructured business problem and carry it end-to-end: from framing the problem and finding the real root cause, through assessing business value and economics, to stakeholder alignment, execution and a result that holds. You will report directly to the Operations Lead and work across the company as a senior individual contributor.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with no direct reports at the start. It is not a coordination role and not a pure strategy role. It is for someone who wants to grow as a full Senior Business Operator by solving real business problems, with direct exposure to C-level and to the core Growth functions of the company.

Role responsibilities

  • Own complex cross-functional initiatives end-to-end: structure the problem, plan the approach, align stakeholders, manage dependencies and risks, make decisions and drive execution through to a result.
  • Break down problems and opportunities across Growth, Marketing and Monetization: identify root causes and bottlenecks, assess business value, economics and trade-offs, and recommend what should be changed, launched, scaled or stopped.
  • Analyse and redesign processes, ownership and the way teams work together; introduce new operating mechanisms and ways of working.
  • Lead individual launches and initiatives related to acquisition, creative production, funnels, monetization and Growth scaling.
  • Build governance, repeatable processes, playbooks, decision-making rules and feedback loops between Growth, Marketing, Monetization and other functions.
  • Work daily with senior stakeholders across Growth, Growth Tech, Creative Production, Product, Analytics, Platform, Payments and Finance, and move initiatives forward without formal authority.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in Operations, Business Operations, Growth Operations, Strategy & Operations, Program Management or Transformation.
  • Experience in a large, systemic company or a scale-up environment where you personally built or substantially improved scalable processes, operating models, governance or cross-functional systems.
  • Practical experience with a Growth / Performance Marketing context: paid acquisition, marketing funnels, web2web and/or web2app models, Growth economics, and regular work with Growth, Performance Marketing, Creative Production, Product, Analytics and Monetization teams.
  • A proven track record of running complex cross-functional initiatives end-to-end, with many stakeholders, dependencies and high operational complexity.
  • Regular work with senior stakeholders and decision-making under high uncertainty and unclear ownership.
  • Complex project and program management, problem structuring and root-cause analysis.
  • Growth and performance marketing business acumen: paid acquisition, funnel economics, CAC/CPA, ROAS/ROI, LTV, payback, conversion rates and the main drivers of profitable growth; understanding of the chain paid acquisition -> creative -> funnel -> conversion -> monetization -> business outcome.
  • Business and financial acumen: unit economics, P&L logic, revenue and cost drivers, contribution margin, ROI and payback, basic business case modelling; understanding of creative testing and scaling logic at business level.
  • Process design and optimisation, risk and dependency management, stakeholder management, KPI and metrics design.
  • Strong analytical and spreadsheet skills, and executive-level written communication.
  • High ownership and autonomy, structured thinking and strong business judgment, ability to influence without authority, high tolerance for ambiguity, bias for action, direct and pragmatic communication, ability to push back constructively, and reliable follow-through.

Will be a plus

  • Experience in a high-volume performance marketing or high-volume creative production and testing environment.

About Salesforce

  • Strategic Lifecycle Actions: Translate ecosystem telemetry into definitive operational recommendations, such as sunsetting underperforming solutions or doubling down on trending technical categories.

  • Public Representation: Present as a trusted platform expert at major community events and conferences (e.g., Dreamforce, World Tours, Community Dreamin’ events), demonstrating the "Art of the Possible" using Labs solutions.

  • 10+ Years of Leadership: Extensive experience in program management, technical product management, or GTM strategy within a high-growth SaaS enterprise.

  • Proven Influence Without Authority: Documented success leading massive, cross-functional matrixed initiatives and aligning executive stakeholders up to the SVP/EVP level without direct reports.

  • Security Program Experience: Strong background navigating complex software security reviews, managing high-stakes client/partner escalations, or designing program operational structures.

Lead the response to customer escalations, ensuring related actions are followed through to resolution with the applicable team members.

Can lead change, comfortable with ambiguity and able to support the team by building their resilience and managing emotions. Experience working effectively with all levels of management. Experience handling critical customer concerns.

  • Execution: Ability to lead multiple projects while maintaining strict attention to details. Ability to adapt quickly to new or changing business requirements.

About the Client

A US healthcare technology company running an API-driven platform is hiring a Tech Support Specialist to own front-line technical triage and turn client-reported integration issues into clean, complete escalations.

The client serves US-based customers in a HIPAA-regulated environment with a structured support organization and defined Tier 1 to Tier 2 escalation paths. A company-wide migration from Zendesk to Salesforce is underway over the next 2–3 months, and systems and processes evolve on roughly a two-month cycle as the platform scales.

About the Role

This role handles 20–30 tickets daily plus roughly 10 short inbound calls, reviewing client-submitted API payloads and requests, identifying missing or incorrectly filled fields, and determining whether an issue is a bug, a user error, or a configuration problem before it reaches Tier 2. This is a Tier 1 position with strong technical fundamentals, not a Tier 2 role requiring log analysis or system-level debugging. Success means matching existing team performance benchmarks within 2–3 weeks and demonstrating efficient, well-documented technical escalations within the first 30 days.

Core Responsibilities

Technical Triage & Escalation

  • Review client-submitted API payloads and requests to identify missing or incorrectly filled fields.
  • Run first-line troubleshooting steps and guide clients through resolution walkthroughs before escalating.
  • Classify each issue as a bug, user error, or configuration problem.
  • Package complete context and replication steps so Tier 2 does not need to re-triage.

Ticket Management

  • Manage 20–30 tickets daily with clear, professional written responses.
  • Maintain ticket hygiene by updating statuses accurately and closing resolved issues promptly.
  • Track open bug tickets and escalate when immediate closure is not possible.
  • Meet or exceed team benchmarks for response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.

Phone Support

  • Handle approximately 10 inbound calls per day, averaging 2–4 minutes each.
  • Resolve technical questions in real time over the phone with US-based clients.
  • Translate technical findings into plain language for non-technical callers.

Platform Migration & Tool Adoption

  • Support the company-wide transition from Zendesk to Salesforce over the next 2–3 months.
  • Apply prior Salesforce experience to shorten ramp time during the migration.
  • Adopt new tools and revised processes as the support stack evolves.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • 3+ years in customer or technical support, including time in a technical support function with regular escalations to Tier 2 or engineering (2+ years considered with heavy technical support experience at a large company)
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting API or integration issues, including reviewing client payloads or requests to identify missing or incorrectly formatted fields
  • Salesforce experience in a support or CRM context, with 6+ months of active use
  • Experience managing 20+ tickets daily in a structured ticketing system (Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Freshdesk, or equivalent)
  • Inbound phone support experience with US-based clients, handling live verbal troubleshooting rather than chat- or email-only queues
  • Documented experience through a platform migration or frequent tool and process changes (e.g., onboarded to a new CRM or ticketing system within 30 days)

Nice-to-Have

Principal Product Manager

Location: Bengaluru, Coimbatore, India (Remote)

About AppViewX:

AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole’s 2025 Non-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.

Our Values

Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.

  • We Do What We Say: We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
  • We Are Trusted Experts: We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
  • We Raise the Bar: We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
  • We Win Together: We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to work with the Director of Product and help set the strategic direction for our Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) product line. This is a senior, high-impact individual contributor role: you will own the planning and execution for CLM, help shape company-level bets on where crypto-agility and CLM automation are headed, and act as the most senior product voice across a portfolio of related modules and initiatives.

You will operate with significant autonomy, partnering directly with engineering leadership, design, sales, and executive stakeholders to translate market and regulatory shifts into a coherent, differentiated roadmap. You will also raise the bar for the broader product organization, mentoring senior and mid-level PMs, setting standards for discovery and requirements gathering, and representing AppViewX’s CLM strategy with customers, and industry forums.

You bring deep product instincts, sharp executive and customer communication, and strong technical fluency in PKI and certificate management. You are comfortable operating ambiguously at the strategy layer while still being able to go deep into requirements, architecture trade-offs, and cross-functional execution when it matters most.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the roadmap for Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), aligning it with company strategy, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and enterprise customer needs.
  • Act as the senior product strategist for CLM, setting priorities across multiple modules and workstreams and ensuring coherence across the broader product portfolio.
  • Lead deep discovery engagements with enterprise customers, PKI architects, and customer stakeholders to surface strategic pain points around certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and visibility.
  • Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, eIDAS, FIPS 140-2) into a coherent, forward-looking set of product capabilities and standards.
  • Define AppViewX’s point of view and product response to major industry shifts, including post-quantum cryptography (PQC), short-lived certificates (47-day validity), and Zero Trust models, working closely with engineering and architecture teams.
  • Set the bar for product requirements quality across the team, writing and reviewing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the most complex, ambiguous, or cross-cutting initiatives.
  • Mentor and coach senior and mid-level PMs, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the overall maturity of product practices, documentation, and process across the organization.
  • Collaborate closely with Design on the end-to-end experience for certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal automation, and policy enforcement, ensuring consistency across a growing product portfolio.
  • Represent AppViewX’s CLM product strategy and roadmap externally with key customers, prospects, and at conferences or forums as needed.
  • Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and technical field teams aligning diverse stakeholders from individual contributors to the C-suite around a shared strategic direction.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 4+ years operating at a senior/lead or principal level owning strategy for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning product strategy end-to-end, from market analysis and vision-setting through execution, launch, and iteration at scale.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills; experienced with product analytics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and using data to inform multi-quarter strategic bets.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence senior executives and align cross-functional stakeholders spanning engineering, design, technical sales, and leadership.
  • Significant experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government, telecoms), including direct engagement with security and compliance stakeholders.
  • Proven experience managing complex, API-first products and platform-level integrations.
  • Experience mentoring or leading other product managers, or otherwise operating as a force multiplier for a product organization.

Domain Expertise (Preferred):

Direct CLM or PKI leadership experience is strongly preferred. Candidates who can demonstrate the following will have a significant advantage:

  • Deep, strategic understanding of a CLM or PKI management platform, including X.509 certificate standards, certificate authorities (public and private), trust chains, and revocation mechanisms (CRL, OCSP).
  • Familiarity with certificate enrollment protocols: ACME, SCEP, EST, and REST-based CA APIs, and how they shape automation and integration strategy.
  • Experience setting strategy for automation workflows, and working knowledge of HSM (Hardware Security Module), key management, and cryptographic policy enforcement at an enterprise scale.

What’s more in store?

AppViewX is on par with leading global companies when it comes to the benefits it offers its employees, ranging from competitive incentives, health & wellness policies, saving & investment schemes, time off/sabbatical eligibility and dedicated L&D.

What we consider equally important is the flexibility we offer our employees to – work remotely, define their own hours, and more importantly harmonize both work and life. The more trust and accountability we place on our employees, the more they surpass our goals and expectations.

Why AppViewX?

AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.

AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.
